stories.h: B. Lyle passes on the portal, stays buried and patient at Ohio State
stories.d: After a week on Portal Watch, [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the window open. Buried on the depth chart, he has decided the grass isn't obviously greener elsewhere.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: D. Quinn was on our list. Ohio State says he's going nowhere
stories.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] sat a week on Portal Watch as a depth-chart casualty, but he remains at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, Tuddy_roosevelt's staff sat down with him early and the message landed.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: C. Woods stays at Ohio State, and the bill is coming
stories.d: [[p:557716955|C.Woods]] came off Portal Watch still wearing scarlet, but his rating jump means other collectives will keep calling. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has deep pockets, and a source says an extension conversation is expected.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: L. Jerman won't test the market, to Ohio State's relief
stories.d: [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] rose enough to draw interest, but he's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Rival staffs reportedly checked in anyway. The Buckeyes now have to prove loyalty gets rewarded.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Freshman corner J. Blue is now an 85, and Ohio State has a decision
stories.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] jumped eight points thanks to Impact development, and he's already earning 110K in NIL, well above the 50K median for corners his rating. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] is first nationally in NIL strength, so a raise is easy. Keeping rivals away is the harder part.

quote.text: He's already paid like a star. Nobody's complaining in that room, but other schools are calling.

stories.h: N. Pullard's leap to 85 puts Penn State's NIL budget to work
stories.d: The sophomore corner is up six points on Elite development and earning 60K, a bit above the 50K median for his rating. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks second nationally in NIL, and agerm40 has reason to lock him in before his stock climbs any more.

quote.text: Corners like that don't stay quiet once the portal chatter starts.

stories.h: L. Bey, an 89-overall weapon, is stuck in a passing game that barely functions
stories.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 121st of 138 in receptions, a rough landing for a threat back like [[p:557726994|L.Bey]]. Per a source, his camp has noticed. Players in his spot often listen to offers, and Tuddy_roosevelt needs a plan.

quote.text: You don't want a guy like that touching it a handful of times in the passing game. He'll look around.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

stories.h: Nebraska Holds the Edge for J. Tyree, But LSU Is Pushing Hard
stories.d: Nebraska is in front for [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]], with LSU close behind and Georgia lurking. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to spend the week selling him on an early role.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: B. Ghee Stays at Ohio State Despite Portal Watch Buzz
stories.d: [[p:557719613|B.Ghee]] spent a week on Portal Watch as a buried name on the depth chart. The portal is open, and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Staff conversations appear to have mattered.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Lucas Isn't Leaving Ohio State, Whatever the Depth Chart Says
stories.d: [[p:557717941|R.Lucas]] was on Portal Watch for a week and is still in the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] fold. After a rough stretch of departures in Columbus, a player who stays is news. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff will take it.

quote.text: He's not looking for the exit. He wants to earn it here.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: C. Knighten Stays Put at East Carolina as Portal Chatter Fades
stories.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] was a Portal Watch name for a week, stuck down the depth chart. He's still on the [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] roster. Pirate_flag's staff apparently made the case for patience.

quote.text: Coaches were straight with him about the plan. He appreciated that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: L. Bey Is Staying at Ohio State, Scheme Concerns and All
stories.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] was flagged as a bad scheme fit, yet he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Staying is one thing. Finding a role in this system is the harder part.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Freshman Receiver C. Woods Is Surging, and Ohio State Will Have to Pay
stories.d: [[p:557716955|C.Woods]] has jumped to 81 overall and is earning 55K in NIL. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has the deepest pockets in the country, but rival staffs are reportedly taking note of a freshman who's outplaying his deal.

quote.text: That number is going up soon. If it doesn't, someone else will make the call.

stories.h: Ohio State Edge L. Jerman Is Climbing Fast and Due a Bigger Check
stories.d: The freshman pass rusher is now 78 overall on a 125K NIL deal. [[p:557722886|L.Jerman]] is a good problem for [[t:832438359|Ohio State]], which has the resources to keep him. Whether it acts before rivals call is the question.

stories.h: Penn State's K. Wilkes Is Playing Above His 85K Deal
stories.d: [[p:557713589|K.Wilkes]] has climbed to 79 overall as a freshman receiver. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has the second-deepest NIL pockets nationally, and agerm40's staff is expected to adjust his deal before the portal market gets ideas.

quote.text: You don't wait on a kid like that. You get ahead of it.

stories.h: M. Carver Is a Coverage Safety on a Defense That Can't Cover
stories.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 80-overall coverage specialist at [[t:832438366|Penn State]], which ranks 126th of 138 in pass defense. Agents and rival staffs are reportedly watching to see if he tests the market.

quote.text: Guys like that want to play on a defense that lets them make plays. That's a fair question to ask.

stories.h: J. Smith Is an 89-Overall Safety Making Nothing, and Georgia Should Worry
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] earns nothing in NIL while safeties of his caliber go for around 110K. Georgia has the third-deepest pockets in the country, but rival collectives are reportedly circling a star who's well underpaid.

quote.text: Everybody knows the market. He's got to be hearing from people.

stories.h: A. Rowden Earns Nothing at Texas Tech, and Rival Collectives Are Calling
stories.d: An 86-overall running back with no NIL deal is an easy target when comparable backs command around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has the money. [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is waiting to see if it uses it.

quote.text: It's only a matter of time before somebody offers him real money.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Texas Is Getting a Bargain at QB in K. Lacey Jr., But Not for Long
stories.d: [[p:557717478|K.Lacey Jr.]] is an 85-overall quarterback on 55K, while similar passers go for around 155K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the pockets to fix it. Others have noticed the gap.

quote.text: A quarterback like that gets calls every week. Texas can't ignore it.

stories.h: B. Lyle Is Stuck Behind the Starter at Ohio State, and Teams Are Watching
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is an 82-overall sophomore quarterback with just 5 snaps in 16 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and the depth chart in Columbus offers no clear path.

quote.text: He's too good to sit this long. His people are listening to offers.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: J. Gordon Is a Star Running Back Without an NIL Deal, and Rivals Know It
stories.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s [[p:557715455|J.Gordon]] is an 85-overall back earning nothing while peers at his rating command around 60K. Rival collectives are circling, and the Volunteers face a portal fight if they don't act.

quote.text: The offers will come. The only question is whether Tennessee matches them.

stories.h: D. Quinn Is Third on Ohio State's Depth Chart and Unlikely to Wait
stories.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] is an 81-overall sophomore edge rusher who hasn't played a snap in 16 games. With the portal open, plenty of programs would start him. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] could lose another body.

quote.text: He's frustrated. Nobody can blame him if he looks elsewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: T. Hornes Is an 87-Overall Receiver With No Production, and the Staff Is Restless
stories.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has no catches for no yards in 3 games. His team could shop the portal at his position, and the receiver could look for a new offense. The ratings haven't translated.

quote.text: You can't carry an 87 who isn't getting the ball. Something has to change.

stories.h: USC Fans Are Restless as R. Marriott Piles Up Interceptions
stories.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 14 picks against 13 touchdowns, with a 142.0 rating. [[t:832438398|USC]] could be looking at the portal for a quarterback, and the Trojans' supporters aren't hiding their frustration.

quote.text: Nobody's happy with the turnovers. The staff has to look at every option.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Miami Holds Razor-Thin Edge for K. Kane, but Georgia Won't Back Down
stories.d: The four-star back is down to a playing-time decision. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slight lead over [[t:832438312|Georgia]], and Missouri is lurking. One more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's touching the ball in September. Whoever shows him that wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Freshman Tackle S. Orlando Is Playing Himself Into a Raise Northwestern May Not Cover
stories.d: [[p:557722079|S.Orlando]] has leaped to 77 overall and is earning nothing in NIL. [[t:832438356|Northwestern]] ranks 75th in NIL spending, and rival staffs have noticed.

quote.text: You see that tape and you wonder who's even paying him. Somebody should be calling.

stories.h: P.Carver's Rapid Rise Puts Louisiana Tech in a Bind
stories.d: The freshman receiver is up 15 points to 78 overall and earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438331|Louisiana Tech]] ranks 125th in NIL spending. [[p:557720529|P.Carver]] is exactly the type of player who gets a text from a bigger program.

quote.text: Guys like that don't stay quiet for long. Everybody's going to find out about him.
quote.by: a Group of Five personnel director

stories.h: M.O'Dell Is Now an 80, and Texas State Is Running Out of Time
stories.d: [[p:557714455|M.O'Dell]] has made a 13-point jump as a freshman receiver. [[t:832438386|Texas State]], 82nd in NIL spending, hasn't paid him a cent yet.

stories.h: Pittsburgh's Defensive Breakout Is Going to Get Expensive
stories.d: [[p:557723934|D.Fort]] has gone from promising to 85 overall at middle linebacker, up 12 points in a week. [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] isn't paying him anything yet, and sources say that has to change soon.

quote.text: Linebackers who play like that don't stay on a free deal. The market corrects itself.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

stories.h: Louisville Has a Star Guard on Its Hands and Nothing in the Budget
stories.d: [[p:557716252|M.Ogundeji]] jumped to 83 overall and still earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438332|Louisville]] ranks 74th in NIL spending, and a sophomore with that growth curve won't stay overlooked.

stories.h: B.Ghee Is Too Good for the Bench. How Long Does He Wait?
stories.d: The 83-overall sophomore edge rusher has played just 131 snaps in 16 games. [[p:557719613|B.Ghee]] has people around him asking whether a starting job is waiting elsewhere. Several portal programs would start him on day one.

quote.text: He's a starter somewhere. He knows it, and everybody around him knows it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: With Oregon's Pass Defense Struggling, J.Washington Could Look Elsewhere
stories.d: [[p:557728693|J.Washington]] is an 89-overall hybrid safety on a defense that ranks 128th of 138 against the pass. Oregon already had to open the wallet for I. Obidegwu, and rival staffers expect that won't be the last such call.

quote.text: If you're an 89 and your defense is giving up yards every week, you start listening.

stories.h: A.Rowden Is Stuck on Texas Tech's Bench, and Suitors Know It
stories.d: An 88-overall sophomore running back with just 6 snaps in 14 games is the kind of player who gets calls. [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] might not wait around Lubbock much longer.

quote.text: Nobody is giving a back that good six snaps. He's going to want a bigger role.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: R.Marriott's Interceptions Are Beginning to Outpace His Touchdowns
stories.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 13 touchdowns and 14 picks, posting a 142.0 rating. That's far from what you expect from an 89-overall quarterback. Don't be surprised if his coaches start scanning the portal.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The production isn't, and that's the conversation in the building.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: T.Hornes Is Rated 88 and Hasn't Caught a Pass
stories.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has zero catches for zero yards in three games. His coaches may look at the portal for help at receiver. The ratings say he's a star; the stat sheet isn't backing it up.

quote.text: You can't have an 88 sitting there. Something's not working with the usage or the fit.
quote.by: an assistant coach at a rival school

stories.h: R.Lucas Is Too Good to Sit, and Portal Teams Are Watching
stories.d: An 80-overall sophomore edge rusher who has played 143 snaps in 16 games isn't likely to stay patient forever. [[p:557717941|R.Lucas]] would start tomorrow for plenty of programs.

stories.h: T.Beard Has Zero Catches at LSU. Is a New Role or New Team Next?
stories.d: [[p:557712883|T.Beard]] is an 86-overall receiver with no catches and no yards in 13 games. [[t:832438333|LSU]] keeps adding talent, and he'll have to win the job back in camp.

quote.text: He's a good player, but right now the receiver room is crowded and he's behind.
quote.by: a source close to the LSU program

stories.h: T.Norman Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Production Isn't There
stories.d: [[p:557725640|T.Norman]] is an 85-overall receiver with only 2 catches for 14 yards in 13 games. On a ranked team, that's not enough, and he'll have to earn the job back in camp.

quote.text: The ratings say star. The film says role player. He needs a big offseason.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

stories.h: R.Wesley on a 2-10 Michigan Team Could Be Portal's Top Prize
stories.d: [[p:557728716|R.Wesley]] is an 89-overall sophomore edge rusher on a Michigan team that went 2-10. If he hits the portal, expect a bidding war and an offseason storyline.

quote.text: Every staff in the country would pick up the phone for him. It'd be a frenzy.

stories.h: Michigan State's Z.Johnson Deserves Better Than 4-9. Contenders Are Circling
stories.d: [[p:557716998|Z.Johnson]] is an 89-overall junior running back on a 4-9 Michigan State team. Contenders know his name, and sources say the phones are already warming up.

quote.text: A back like that on a team going nowhere? Somebody's going to make a push.
quote.by: a portal-focused staffer at a power program

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: C. Henry Jr. picks LSU after a price negotiation that scared off rivals
stories.d: The five-star receiver's reported $620K ask kept some suitors from getting serious. [[t:832438333|LSU]] met it and sold [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]] on a passing game that moves.

quote.text: It's a business too. They made it make sense.

stories.h: Alabama's DB pipeline wins J. Edwards over Tennessee and Oregon
stories.d: [[r:561122034|J. Edwards]] looked hard at [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. In the end, [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s record of putting defensive backs in the league, plus a thin safety room, won out.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: Indiana lands No. 11 overall I. Iheanacho, and winning did the recruiting
stories.d: A top-15 tackle picks a [[t:832438319|Indiana]] program that is 11-3 and ranked No. 7. A source close to [[r:561122097|I. Iheanacho]] says the staff's track record of developing linemen for the pros sealed it.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: Colorado hands No. 14 overall J. Waletzko the keys to a quick start
stories.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is 15-1 and ranked No. 4, and it told [[r:561122106|J. Waletzko]] he can play right away. For a top-15 talent, that combination is hard to beat.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Miami's title pitch lands J. Edmonds over LSU and Indiana
stories.d: [[r:561122591|J. Edmonds]] wanted a title shot and a clear path to the field. [[t:832438337|Miami]] offered both. Rivals [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] were left to regroup.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Ole Miss pays up and pitches an open job to land QB C. Fleming
stories.d: A reported $385K ask didn't scare [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] off. Per a source, [[r:561121891|C. Fleming]] studied the quarterback room and liked what he saw.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Indiana keeps E. DaSilva close to West Bloomfield and wins a tug-of-war
stories.d: The five-star edge rusher heard from several programs. A short drive for his family and a real title pitch got [[t:832438319|Indiana]] the commitment, according to a person close to [[r:561119757|E. DaSilva]].

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Indiana adds another five-star edge in I. Epenesa, and the depth chart is getting crowded
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]]'s staff promised [[r:561120349|I. Epenesa]] a real shot at the job, and the short trip from Glen Carbon helped. The pass rush is loaded, and someone will have to wait.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: Utah holds off Michigan and Indiana to land five-star D. Iorio
stories.d: [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]] chose [[t:832438400|Utah]] over [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]], and the finish was tighter than the staff let on. A source says the linebacker room and the defensive scheme were the difference.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: C. Virgin picks Colorado over SMU and Notre Dame, and the message is clear
stories.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]], 15-1 and ranked No. 4, sold [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]] on a quick path to the field. [[t:832438375|SMU]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] both pushed. Neither could match the pitch.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: C. Henry Jr. makes it official with LSU after a pricey chase
stories.d: The former Ohio State receiver is signed. Per a source, the final negotiation with [[t:832438333|LSU]] got done quickly once [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]] saw the reported $620K number he wanted.

stories.h: Tennessee signs five-star QB F. Brandon on a passing-game pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] has the nation's top passing offense, and [[r:561121023|F. Brandon]] is the next piece. If the Vols can keep landing stars like this, the title pitch gets easier.

stories.h: Notre Dame signs five-star CB B. Arrington into a thin room
stories.d: [[r:561121915|B. Arrington]] is [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s latest five-star signing. With only two cornerbacks back, he could see the field as a freshman, and a source says the staff made that clear.

stories.h: LSU signs T. Keys, and now the receiver room is loaded
stories.d: [[r:561121027|T. Keys]] wanted a power-conference stage and picked [[t:832438333|LSU]]. A source says the staff pitched him a role alongside [[r:561122564|C. Henry Jr.]], not behind him.

stories.h: Notre Dame seals five-star safety J. O'Brien with national-stage pitch
stories.d: [[r:561122239|J. O'Brien]] wanted maximum exposure, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s brand delivered. It was the big-stage pitch that closed this one.

stories.h: J. Cantwell signs with Notre Dame after an early-playing-time pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]'s staff told [[r:561119403|J. Cantwell]] he can compete for a job right away. A source close to the program says the Irish keep winning recruits with that message.

stories.h: J. Edwards signs with Alabama, betting on its defensive back factory
stories.d: [[r:561122034|J. Edwards]] is officially a Crimson Tide signee. [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s history of producing DBs for the league convinced him, and a source says the staff's follow-up calls were relentless.

stories.h: K. Adams signs with Notre Dame, chasing a title
stories.d: [[r:561123004|K. Adams]] wanted a championship contender, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] grades out at the top of the list. The Irish run through signing day keeps rolling.

stories.h: Oklahoma lands five-star Z. Elee as the NIL checks keep clearing
stories.d: [[r:561121465|Z. Elee]] fits a pass rush that is among the nation's best. A source says [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]'s NIL money didn't hurt, and rival staffs are taking notice.

stories.h: Indiana makes I. Iheanacho's commitment official
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has its franchise left tackle. [[r:561122097|I. Iheanacho]] signed after a recruitment that leaned on the program's record of sending linemen to the pros.

stories.h: Oregon signs C. Morgan, who wanted a shot at a title
stories.d: [[r:561119362|C. Morgan]] is official with [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. A source says the Ducks' championship pitch carried the day, a small win for a program that has had a tough week in recruiting.

stories.h: D. Odoms signs with Miami for the offense and the pace
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]]'s offense is one of the nation's most productive, and [[r:561123022|D. Odoms]] saw an agile playmaker's dream. A source says the Hurricanes' staff sold the scheme on every visit.

stories.h: Colorado makes J. Waletzko's signing official
stories.d: The No. 14 overall prospect is signed, and [[t:832438295|Colorado]] has already told [[r:561122106|J. Waletzko]] to prepare to compete for a job. The Buffs' winning record sold the rest.

stories.h: X. Griffin signs with Indiana and another title-seeker joins the class
stories.d: [[r:561121848|X. Griffin]] wanted a contender, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has become one. The Hoosiers' class keeps growing, and rivals are scrambling.

stories.h: K. Obot signs with Notre Dame, the latest in a heavy week
stories.d: [[r:561120849|K. Obot]] wanted a title shot, and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] provided it. The Irish have been closing hard, and rival recruiters admit it.

stories.h: J. Edmonds signs with Miami, and the CB room gets a lift
stories.d: [[r:561122591|J. Edmonds]] is official with [[t:832438337|Miami]]. The program's win over Ohio State is still paying off on the trail, and a title shot was the draw.

stories.h: Oklahoma seals five-star REDG C. Meadows, doubling down on its pass rush
stories.d: [[r:561121698|C. Meadows]] joins [[r:561121465|Z. Elee]] at [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]. A source says the NIL spending was a factor, but the scheme sold him too.

stories.h: C. Fleming signs with Ole Miss and gets his shot at the QB job
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] told [[r:561121891|C. Fleming]] he could compete immediately. A source close to the program says the staff is already planning for him to push for the starting job.

stories.h: Georgia seals five-star WILL T. Atkinson with a playing-time pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] told [[r:561122048|T. Atkinson]] he can compete for a job right away. The win comes as the staff tries to show it can hold its own roster too, after keeping J. Smith.

stories.h: D. Odem III signs with Notre Dame, and the CB room is now crowded
stories.d: [[r:561121222|D. Odem III]] joins [[r:561121915|B. Arrington]] in a cornerback room that was thin. A source says the staff pitched an open competition, and now it has one.

stories.h: E. DaSilva makes it official, picks Indiana to chase a title
stories.d: The Hoosiers keep stacking their class. Indiana's championship-contender profile was the hook, and DaSilva's camp reportedly never took another visit seriously once the Hoosiers got serious.

quote.text: He wanted to play for a title, and Indiana was the only place that felt like that every day.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Indiana adds five-star edge I. Epenesa, and the class keeps growing
stories.d: Epenesa signs with Indiana after the staff told him he could compete for a starting job right away. Rival recruiters say the Hoosiers' pitch of playing time plus a title window is hard to beat.

quote.text: Nobody else was straight with him about snaps like Indiana was.

stories.h: Utah closes on five-star D. Iorio and wins a tug-of-war
stories.d: The scheme fit sold Iorio. Utah ranks 7th in total tackles (173), and a hitter at SAM saw himself in that defense. Staffs around the league had spent weeks hoping he'd drift elsewhere.

quote.text: He watched Utah's tape and said, 'That's where I'd be flying around.'
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Colorado signs five-star athlete C. Virgin on a playing-time pitch
stories.d: Virgin picks Colorado after being told a job is there to compete for from day one. The staff has been selling versatility all cycle, and this was the payoff.

quote.text: They told him he'd touch the ball and he believed them.
quote.by: a person familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: N. Burroughs picks Georgia over Florida State and Georgia Tech
stories.d: Georgia has just two returning receivers, and its NIL spending ranks 3rd. Burroughs reportedly asked for $340K, and the Bulldogs were willing to meet it. Florida State and Georgia Tech were left on the outside.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: D. Geralds chooses Auburn, calling the NFL track record the difference
stories.d: Auburn has sent four defensive linemen to the draft in four years, one in the first round, and has just three returning tackles. Illinois and Michigan both thought they were in good shape late.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: B. Hanks III picks Florida State over Clemson and Auburn
stories.d: With just three returning corners, Florida State offered a quick path to the field. The Seminoles' conference prestige did the rest, and Clemson's staff is said to be disappointed.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Oregon lands four-star guard D. Lee on a ring-chasing pitch
stories.d: Oregon grades out an A+ as a championship contender and has just two returning guards. Lee's camp reportedly liked how quickly the Ducks laid out his path to the field.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Iron Bowl win helps Auburn land Z. Helton from Florida and Alabama
stories.d: Auburn's 47-42 rivalry win over Alabama came at just the right time. Helton was in the stands, and the short drive from Carrollton made the decision easier. Alabama's staff reportedly knew the game hurt them.

quote.text: That win over Alabama? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

stories.h: Ohio State keeps A. Rogers after five weeks on Portal Watch
stories.d: A. Rogers was buried on the depth chart and looked like a likely departure. He's still on the roster. The Buckeyes needed a win in a week full of bad news, and reportedly got one with a direct sales job.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Michigan talks flight risk S. Hiter into staying with a bigger NIL deal
stories.d: Hiter spent six weeks on Portal Watch while stuck on a losing team. Michigan's answer was money: his NIL rose from 115K to 195K. The decision was not an easy one for him.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a person close to the situation

stories.h: Penn State holds on to J. Zayas despite scheme-fit chatter
stories.d: Zayas had been tagged on Portal Watch as a bad fit, but he's still on the roster. agerm40's staff gets a quiet win during a noisy portal period.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: N. Pullard sticks at Penn State after a rating jump
stories.d: Pullard's rating bump made him a potential target for bigger offers, but he's remaining with the Nittany Lions. agerm40 needed some stability after a week of departures.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Blue isn't leaving Ohio State, whatever Portal Watch said
stories.d: Blue's rating jump had him on the list, but he's still a Buckeye. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff takes a small positive in a rough portal week.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State keeps S. Boyce out of the portal
stories.d: Boyce was about to get expensive after a rating jump and drew attention elsewhere, but he is staying. The Buckeyes are counting every player they keep.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State loses 19 to the portal, 14 of them four-stars or better
stories.d: Chris Henry Jr., Jerquaden Guilford and Tavien St. Clair are among those gone. Tuddy_roosevelt now faces the biggest rebuild in the league, and boosters are said to be watching how fast he responds.

quote.text: You can't lose this many talented players and say it's normal.

stories.h: Penn State sees 13 players enter the portal, three of them four-stars
stories.d: Jahmir Joseph, Christian Flanagan and Owen Aliciene lead the group out. agerm40 has holes at corner and quarterback, and the next few weeks will show whether he can fill them.

quote.text: It's a lot of change in the secondary and at quarterback.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: East Carolina sees 12 players leave, edge rusher Ethan Wilson among them
stories.d: Ethan Wilson, Ashton Gray and Donnell Mitchell lead a dozen portal entries. Pirate_flag now has to find an edge presence and replace depth at skill spots.

quote.text: Losing Wilson hurts. That's the one they'll feel most.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: I. West leaves Ohio State, just as TD Wire flagged
stories.d: West spent four weeks buried on the depth chart and is now in the portal. He is one more name leaving Tuddy_roosevelt's roster.

quote.text: He didn't see playing time coming. It was time to look.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: D. Jones leaves Ohio State's depth chart behind for the portal
stories.d: Jones had been flagged for two weeks, stuck behind others. He's now gone, leaving another hole in Tuddy_roosevelt's rebuild.

quote.text: He wanted a real shot to play and didn't feel he'd get one.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: J. Joseph exits Penn State, a scheme mismatch that finally cracked
stories.d: Joseph had been flagged for three weeks as a bad fit. He's now in the portal. agerm40 loses a four-star corner and a lot of secondary depth.

quote.text: He never felt comfortable in what they asked him to do.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: C. Flanagan enters the portal and Penn State needs a quarterback plan
stories.d: Flanagan's rating jump made him a prime target. He's now in the portal, and agerm40 has a hole at a premium position.

quote.text: Teams are going to call him all week. He has a market.

stories.h: L. Andrews leaves Penn State as the scheme-fit warning comes true
stories.d: Andrews was flagged for a week as a bad fit for the scheme. He is now in the portal, adding to a rough run for agerm40.

quote.text: It never really clicked for him.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: T. St. Clair, under fire for his numbers, enters the portal
stories.d: St. Clair had been flagged for a week while taking heat for his production. He is gone from Ohio State, one more quarterback question for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He knew it was time for a fresh start.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: Is LSU ready to move on from running back D. Jones?
stories.d: Jones has 69 carries for 230 yards, just 3.3 a carry. That is not enough for an 85-overall back on a ranked team, and the staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The production just hasn't matched the rating.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R. Marriott was supposed to be a star. The numbers say otherwise
stories.d: Marriott has thrown 13 touchdowns and 14 interceptions, with a 142.0 rating. For an 86-overall quarterback, that's a problem, and don't be surprised if his staff checks the portal at the position.

quote.text: You can't have more picks than touchdowns and call it a good year.

stories.h: Ratings say 86. The stat sheet says something else for J. Washington
stories.d: Washington has 106 carries for 421 yards, 4.0 a carry, which falls short of what an 86-overall back should deliver. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The rating says one thing. The tape says another.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Utah clings to the edge for D. Iorio as Michigan refuses to fold
stories.d: Five-star SAM [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]] has told people close to him that playing style will decide it. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] is still pushing hard, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] hasn't gone away.

quote.text: He keeps asking one thing: where will I be used the way I want to be used?
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Michigan State slightly ahead for Melton, but Florida State is hanging close
stories.d: [[r:561123778|C. Melton]] wants a clear path to snaps, and Michigan State's pitch is landing a little better than [[t:832438310|Florida State]]'s. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] is lurking, and one strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to see a depth chart he believes in. Nobody gets a pass on that.
quote.by: a high school coach familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: Tennessee's pass-happy offense wins over F. Brandon, leaving Alabama and SMU behind
stories.d: The dual-threat [[r:561121023|F. Brandon]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] over [[t:832438274|Alabama]] and [[t:832438375|SMU]]. The Vols lead the nation in passing offense and have only one quarterback back, so he sees a short road to the field.

quote.text: The way they throw it around, I fit perfect.

stories.h: Notre Dame gets No. 4 overall B. Arrington with a 'job is yours to win' pitch
stories.d: Corner [[r:561121915|B. Arrington]] is headed to [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], where the depth chart at his position is thin. Per a source, the staff promised real competition from day one, and the NIL package backed it up.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: T. Keys picks LSU, saying he wants the big-league grind every Saturday
stories.d: No. 5 overall [[r:561121027|T. Keys]] is going to [[t:832438333|LSU]], and conference prestige was the deciding factor. A person close to the process said he never really warmed to the idea of a smaller league schedule.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: J. O'Brien wanted the bright lights, and Notre Dame delivered
stories.d: No. 6 overall [[r:561122239|J. O'Brien]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] largely for the national platform. The Irish are building a recruiting class that looks as if it's meant to be on TV every week.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Notre Dame adds five-star tackle J. Cantwell and keeps stacking the trenches
stories.d: [[r:561119403|J. Cantwell]] is the latest blue-chipper to buy what [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] is selling: a real shot at starting now. Rival staffs say the Irish have been the most aggressive on the phones this month.

quote.text: I didn't want to sit. They told me I wouldn't have to.

stories.h: Oklahoma lands five-star edge Z. Elee, and the NIL money did not hurt
stories.d: [[r:561121465|Z. Elee]] fits the way [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] gets after the passer, and the Sooners' checkbook helped close it. League coaches wondering who can keep pace with Oklahoma's spending just got another data point.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: Miami has the edge for M. Shelby, but Ole Miss and Florida State are close
stories.d: Four-star corner [[r:561123999|M. Shelby]] cares about one thing: getting to the NFL. [[t:832438337|Miami]] is slightly ahead of [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], with [[t:832438310|Florida State]] still in the mix, and someone will go home disappointed on signing day.

quote.text: He keeps asking each staff how many guys they've sent to the league. That's his whole thing.
quote.by: a source familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: After toppling No. 2 Ohio State, Miami adds No. 13 overall D. Odoms
stories.d: The win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] left [[t:832438337|Miami]] with recruiting momentum. [[r:561123022|D. Odoms]] committed to the Hurricanes soon after, and Tuddy_roosevelt's staff now has one more name to think about.

quote.text: Seeing them beat the No. 2 team gave me confidence.

stories.h: Indiana's 11-3 season lures X. Griffin away from LSU and Notre Dame
stories.d: [[r:561121848|X. Griffin]] picked [[t:832438319|Indiana]], citing a title shot. The No. 7 Hoosiers beat out [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. A source said the staff won the living-room visit.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Five-star guard K. Obot sees a title path at Notre Dame
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] pitched [[r:561120849|K. Obot]] on a championship contender and a thin interior line, and he bought both. That makes yet another elite lineman for the Irish.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Oklahoma gets another pass rusher in No. 18 overall C. Meadows
stories.d: [[r:561121698|C. Meadows]] is the second elite edge to join [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], which is stacking up sacks and speed. Per a source, the staff's pass-rush plan was a big selling point.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: Georgia lands No. 20 overall T. Atkinson with promise of early role
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has been busy on the recruiting trail while keeping J. Smith in the fold, and [[r:561122048|T. Atkinson]] is the reward. A source said the staff told him he'd compete immediately.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: No. 21 overall D. Odem III is the fifth big name headed to Notre Dame
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] keeps adding defensive backs, and [[r:561121222|D. Odem III]] follows other top commits to South Bend. The pitch is simple: the cornerback room is thin and a job is there to be won.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: LSU leads Indiana for D. Way, but conference prestige could cut either way
stories.d: Four-star WILL [[r:561124974|D. Way]] is weighing conference stature above all else. [[t:832438333|LSU]] holds a slight lead over [[t:832438319|Indiana]], and Michigan State is still around. Official visits may be the deciding factor.

quote.text: He wants to know what it's like on Saturdays in that league. Visits will tell him.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Washington leads for J. Robbins, but Texas' draft pedigree could flip him
stories.d: Washington has the edge for [[r:561123589|J. Robbins]], but he prizes pro potential, and [[t:832438384|Texas]] has produced first-round wideouts. [[t:832438319|Indiana]] is third. One more good week could end it.

quote.text: Texas keeps showing him the draft board. That resonates.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: J. Daulton commits to Oklahoma without much of a fight
stories.d: Rival staffs were never really in the picture for [[r:561121947|J. Daulton]]. The pure runner liked how [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] leans on the ground game, and a source said he told the staff early it was his top choice.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

stories.h: Clemson beats SMU and Alabama for J. Lopez on NFL pitch
stories.d: [[r:561123138|J. Lopez]] chose [[t:832438293|Clemson]] over [[t:832438375|SMU]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. The Tigers' track record of sending receivers to the league and a power-conference slate were enough, per a source.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: T. Harris stays close to Cedartown, picking Clemson over Minnesota and Georgia
stories.d: A short drive from home and a thin safety room swung [[r:561120181|T. Harris]] to [[t:832438293|Clemson]]. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] and [[t:832438312|Georgia]] came up short.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Georgia Tech wins W. Griffin over Kansas State and Clemson
stories.d: [[r:561122619|W. Griffin]] liked the depth chart and the short drive from Treasure Island. [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] beat out [[t:832438325|Kansas State]] and [[t:832438293|Clemson]].

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Nebraska edges Colorado for four-star safety T. Green
stories.d: Conference prestige carried [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] past [[t:832438295|Colorado]] in a late fight for [[r:561120344|T. Green]]. A source said the Buffs thought they had a chance until the final week.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Georgia Tech lands four-star QB G. MacIntyre, who plans to compete immediately
stories.d: [[r:561121933|G. MacIntyre]] chose [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] after the staff pitched him a chance to start right away. The short drive from Franklin made it easier for his family.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: K. Ryan picks Oklahoma over Texas and Clemson, eyeing the quarterback room
stories.d: With one returning quarterback, [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] gave [[r:561123176|K. Ryan]] a clear look at early work. [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] couldn't match the path, and the Sooners' NIL money helped.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Clemson fills tackle need with D. Gray, beating Auburn and SMU
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] returns just two tackles, and [[r:561123182|D. Gray]] saw the opening. He chose the Tigers over [[t:832438281|Auburn]] and [[t:832438375|SMU]], a source said, after the staff showed him how the offense moves.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Florida State beat BYU, and G. Nuckolls texted the coach right away
stories.d: [[r:561122117|G. Nuckolls]] reached out to [[t:832438310|Florida State]] minutes after the win over [[t:832438288|BYU]]. He chose the Seminoles over [[t:832438293|Clemson]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]], and the short drive from Rocky Face sealed it.

quote.text: They beat BYU and I texted the coach right after. I was ready.

stories.h: T. Castro picks Michigan over Colorado, bringing a spotlight pitch to the Wolverines
stories.d: [[r:561120853|T. Castro]] liked the national exposure at [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and the chance to play early, even with four cornerbacks back. [[t:832438295|Colorado]] lost out, and Michigan's staff is still chasing Iorio.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: LSU lands four-star tight end C. Egan with a title pitch
stories.d: [[r:561119612|C. Egan]] wanted a championship-contender label and chose [[t:832438333|LSU]]. A source said the Tigers' NIL offer helped the family feel comfortable.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: C. Butler Jr. barely considered anyone else before choosing Clemson
stories.d: [[r:561121847|C. Butler Jr.]] wanted a bigger platform and found it at [[t:832438293|Clemson]]. A source said rival staffs realized early they were chasing a lost cause, and Clemson's receiver track record sealed it.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Miami's win over Ohio State helps land four-star tight end D. Golladay
stories.d: [[r:561122100|D. Golladay]] went to [[t:832438337|Miami]] after seeing the win over No. 2 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, the Hurricanes also made a strong draft-board pitch to him.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

stories.h: TCU keeps T. Gentry in Texas, and the power-conference label helped
stories.d: [[r:561122115|T. Gentry]], a four-star receiver, picks [[t:832438381|TCU]] and stays near home. Per a source close to the process, his family was always going to have a say, and TCU's standing in its league got him over the line.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Michigan lands M. Roy by selling the NFL pipeline and a thin DT room
stories.d: [[r:561122208|M. Roy]] chooses [[t:832438339|Michigan]] over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] and [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. A source says the Wolverines' draft record on the defensive line did the heavy lifting, and he can see the depth chart for himself.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: LSU makes the money make sense for hometown back H. Berry
stories.d: Four-star halfback [[r:561120193|H. Berry]] stays in Louisiana with [[t:832438333|LSU]]. Sources say the NIL package met his number, and his parents get every home game as a bonus.

quote.text: It's a business too. They made it make sense.

stories.h: Indiana adds J. Petty, and the sack numbers sold a power rusher
stories.d: [[r:561125382|J. Petty]], a four-star defensive tackle, commits to [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. A source close to the program says the staff showed him film of the pass rush, and he wanted a power-conference stage.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: USC wins M. Williams after beating Texas A&M at the right moment
stories.d: Four-star corner [[r:561122683|M. Williams]] picks [[t:832438398|USC]] right after the Trojans' win over No. 20 [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]]. Per a source, the timing and the NFL pitch for defensive backs landed together.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and USC develops DBs better than anybody.

stories.h: Miami's upset of Ohio State is already working on the trail: T. Jones Jr. is in
stories.d: [[r:561120097|T. Jones Jr.]] picks [[t:832438337|Miami]] over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] and [[t:832438312|Georgia]]. The Hurricanes' win over No. 2 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] landed just as he was deciding, and a source says he loved the brand and the attention.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Texas Tech gets J. Vincent with TV exposure and a NIL offer that fit
stories.d: Four-star corner [[r:561120982|J. Vincent]] commits to [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]]. A source close to the recruitment says the national exposure and the NIL number both counted, and rival staffs didn't match either.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Indiana keeps a local linebacker home: J. Ledyard picks the Hoosiers
stories.d: [[r:561120111|J. Ledyard]], a four-star WILL, stays in state with [[t:832438319|Indiana]], which is 11-3 and ranked No. 7. A source says that his family attending games was a big factor and the rankings sealed it.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: L. Giguere picks Michigan for a chance to start right away
stories.d: [[r:561122431|L. Giguere]] chooses [[t:832438339|Michigan]] over [[t:832438293|Clemson]] and [[t:832438277|Arizona State]]. A source close to the family says the staff's promise of a real competition for a job, plus the short drive from Franklin, closed it. It's a second strong week for Michigan.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Georgia Holds Firm: J. Smith Stays Put After Month on Portal Watch
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] spent four weeks on our Portal Watch as an underpaid player and a likely departure. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438312|Georgia]] roster, which is a quiet win for the Bulldogs' staff.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Nebraska and LSU square off for J. Tyree, with Georgia lurking
stories.d: [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]] has made playing time his dealbreaker, and Nebraska holds a slight lead over LSU. Both staffs are expected to go all out this week, and Georgia is not out of it.

quote.text: He keeps asking the same question: where do I actually get on the field? Whoever answers best wins.
quote.by: A source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Utah clings to a slim lead for Iorio as Michigan pushes
stories.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] still holds the edge for five-star SAM [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]], but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has been pitching hard on playing style and refuses to fold. Indiana is hovering in the background.

quote.text: Michigan feels like it's gaining. Utah knows it can't coast.

stories.h: Oregon leads for D. Lee, but Texas Tech is closing in
stories.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has a narrow lead for four-star RG [[r:561125191|D. Lee]], who wants to play for a contender. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] is selling hard, and BYU hasn't gone away. Official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He's going to want to see who's actually built for a title run. That's what this comes down to.
quote.by: A person familiar with Lee's thinking

stories.h: LSU's championship pitch has Egan leaning its way, SMU not done
stories.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] has pulled ahead for [[r:561119612|C. Egan]], who wants a real shot at a title and likes what he hears from the Tigers. SMU is still in it, and Memphis is a dark horse. Official visits come next.

quote.text: LSU's pitch landed. SMU has to flip it in person.
quote.by: A source close to the program

stories.h: Florida State edges ahead for Melton, but Tennessee is hanging around
stories.d: Florida State has the lead for [[r:561123778|C. Melton]], and Michigan State is still pushing. Tennessee is lurking close behind. Melton wants playing time, and one more strong week for the Seminoles could end it.

quote.text: He keeps talking about where he sees himself on Saturdays. That's what matters to him.
quote.by: A source close to the recruitment

stories.h: No. 9 overall K. Adams picks Notre Dame, wants a title
stories.d: [[r:561123004|K. Adams]], the No. 9 overall prospect, is heading to [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. He wanted a championship-level program and saw a thin cornerback room. The Irish just added a player who can start early.

quote.text: I'm chasing a national title. Notre Dame is built for that, and the depth chart is open.

stories.h: Oregon lands five-star WR C. Morgan with a sizable NIL pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has landed five-star WR [[r:561119362|C. Morgan]]. The Ducks pitched a title run and backed it with NIL money, at a reported $440K. Per sources, Morgan's camp was impressed by the ambition.

quote.text: I want to win it all, and Oregon showed me they're serious.

stories.h: Indiana holds a lead for J. Petty, but Texas Tech is lurking
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has the edge for four-star DT [[r:561125382|J. Petty]], who cares most about conference prestige. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] is pushing hard and Pittsburgh remains in it, so expect a busy week.

quote.text: Conference matters a lot to him. That's the bar everyone has to clear.
quote.by: A source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Four-star DT J. Petty backs off his pledge, reopens recruitment
stories.d: [[r:561125382|J. Petty]] has decommitted and is back on the market. Sources say other programs have been in his ear for weeks. Indiana, Texas Tech and Pittsburgh are all making their cases.

quote.text: Nothing's off the table. I'm open again.

stories.h: UCLA lands four-star center N. Punga, fills a need up front
stories.d: [[t:832438394|UCLA]] filled a gaping hole on the offensive line with four-star C [[r:561123261|N. Punga]]. The Bruins have no returning centers, and Punga, who wants to face top competition, will have a clear path to start.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: C. Gipson picks Texas A&M over South Carolina and Colorado
stories.d: [[r:561119754|C. Gipson]] picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] over [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. A reported $315K NIL package and the chance to stay home in Texas carried the day, and a source says family was a big part of it.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.

stories.h: C. Johnson commits to Florida, and it was never close
stories.d: [[r:561120466|C. Johnson]] stays home with [[t:832438308|Florida]]. The Gators are thin at cornerback, he sees a quick path to the field, and his parents can make every home game. Rival staffs were never really in it.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: UCLA grabs four-star WILL L. Priest, who wants a title
stories.d: [[t:832438394|UCLA]] landed four-star WILL [[r:561119481|L. Priest]], who wanted a team that can win a championship and likes how the Bruins are trending. Staying in California, with his parents at home games, didn't hurt.

quote.text: I want to win a title, and I can do it at home.

stories.h: J. Tauanuu picks Oregon over BYU and Miami
stories.d: [[r:561122867|J. Tauanuu]] chose [[t:832438364|Oregon]] over [[t:832438288|BYU]] and [[t:832438337|Miami]]. The Ducks pitched a title run with a reported $370K NIL offer, and the combination won out. Oregon's recruiting momentum is hard to ignore.

quote.text: I'm here to win championships. Oregon is the place to do it.

stories.h: East Carolina lands W. Bequette over Tulane at WR
stories.d: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] beat out [[t:832438390|Tulane]] for [[r:561124827|W. Bequette]], who saw a receiver room with openings and a chance to play early. A source says [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] closed it personally.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: D. Robinson picks Texas over USC and Illinois
stories.d: [[r:561120534|D. Robinson]] picked [[t:832438384|Texas]] over [[t:832438398|USC]] and [[t:832438318|Illinois]]. The Longhorns' track record of developing defensive backs for the NFL did the work, and their win over No. 25 [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] came at the right time.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops DBs better than anybody.

stories.h: Texas gets four-star TE C. Redman, who liked the staff
stories.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] added four-star TE [[r:561123797|C. Redman]], who put the coaching staff first. The recent win over No. 25 [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] helped the pitch. A source says the staff's resume closed it.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

stories.h: Georgia lands four-star tight end B. Meryl from nearby
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] picked up four-star TE [[r:561125256|B. Meryl]], who wanted to play in a power conference and is a short drive from Hillsborough. Another piece for a program that keeps landing talent.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Four-star CB S. Boswell stays home, commits to SMU
stories.d: [[r:561125507|S. Boswell]] is staying in Texas with [[t:832438375|SMU]]. A source says he never seriously considered leaving the state. The Mustangs have bodies at corner, but he sees room to compete.

quote.text: I'm representing Converse. Staying close was always the plan.

stories.h: Baylor adds four-star edge S. Orogbo after rout of Colorado State
stories.d: [[t:832438283|Baylor]] landed four-star REDG [[r:561121086|S. Orogbo]]. The Bears are thin at edge, and their 48-10 win over [[t:832438296|Colorado State]] gave the pitch some juice. A source says Orogbo watched the game.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Cincinnati's D. Hacker stays close, commits to Notre Dame
stories.d: [[r:561125783|D. Hacker]], a four-star ATH, picks [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. The Irish are 11-2 and ranked No. 6, and it's a short drive from Cincinnati. Per a source, the combination left little doubt.

quote.text: I'm representing Cincinnati. Staying close was always the plan.

stories.h: Georgia lands four-star ATH T. Nava, who wanted the spotlight
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] scored four-star ATH [[r:561125041|T. Nava]], who was drawn by national exposure and the staff. The Bulldogs' brand did most of the talking. A source says Nava never wavered once the offer came.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Four-star SAM K. Higbee stays home, commits to Florida
stories.d: [[r:561121370|K. Higbee]] is staying in Florida with the Gators. A source says he never really thought of leaving. [[t:832438308|Florida]] now has two in-state pickups this week, and his mom will see him play every Saturday.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: T. Cheridor picks Texas Tech over SMU, a win in-state
stories.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] beat [[t:832438375|SMU]] for [[r:561124972|T. Cheridor]]. The Red Raiders' pass-heavy system sold him on a role as a possession target. A source says his parents also liked being able to make home games.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.

stories.h: Alabama adds four-star SS S. Toodle, an in-state get
stories.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] landed four-star SS [[r:561120652|S. Toodle]]. The Tide's safety room is thin, so he can play early. A source says family was a big part of his choice to stay home.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Notre Dame lands four-star SAM C. Bush from Shelbyville
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] added four-star SAM [[r:561124636|C. Bush]], who liked the linebacker development and the short drive from Shelbyville. A source says the Irish's NFL track at LB sealed it.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: H0ldStillPlease lands J. Hodgdon for East Carolina over Duke
stories.d: [[r:561123969|J. Hodgdon]] picked [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] over [[t:832438299|Duke]]. [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] made the home visit personally, and the Pirates' power-conference standing didn't hurt. A source says Hodgdon felt wanted.

quote.text: H0ldStillPlease was in my living room. He wanted me more than anybody.

stories.h: Z. Hicks picks Georgia Tech over Alabama and Florida
stories.d: [[r:561122543|Z. Hicks]] stays in Georgia with [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]], turning down [[t:832438274|Alabama]] and [[t:832438308|Florida]]. The Yellow Jackets sold him on an immediate chance to start at safety, and a source says family played a big role.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: Alabama lands four-star DT A. Vallejo with a hefty NIL pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] added four-star DT [[r:561120102|A. Vallejo]]. The Tide is sixth in NIL spending and put up a reported $295K, plus a depth chart with room to start. Another sign Alabama's collective is winning battles.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Alabama gets four-star DT E. Ruffin, a power fit
stories.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] landed four-star DT [[r:561123006|E. Ruffin]]. The Tide's physical run defense, 10th nationally at 122 rush yards allowed per game, drew him in, and the thin tackle room opens a path to play.

quote.text: The way they run the ball, I fit perfect.

stories.h: B. Dugans picks USC after a text sent right after the Texas A&M win
stories.d: The four-star receiver stays home in California. Per a source close to the recruitment, [[t:832438398|USC]] turning [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]], then ranked No. 20, into a statement win sealed what had been a slow burn for [[r:561125338|B. Dugans]].

quote.text: They beat Texas A&M and I texted the coach right after. I was ready.

stories.h: G. Selby sees open QB job and picks Florida over waiting his turn
stories.d: [[t:832438308|Florida]] has one returning quarterback, and the four-star made that room a central part of his decision. The short drive from Hoover for his family didn't hurt. A source says the staff told [[r:561122397|G. Selby]] he would get a real shot at the job.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: C.Knighten stays at East Carolina despite a week on Portal Watch
stories.d: The depth-chart noise didn't push [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] out the door. A source close to the program says Pirate_flag's staff talked with him early and often while the window was open, and he's still on the [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] roster.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: L.Bey stays at Ohio State, scheme-fit concerns and all
stories.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] was on Portal Watch as a poor fit for the scheme, but the portal window is open and he hasn't entered. Tuddy_roosevelt appears to have won a conversation that could have gone the other way for [[t:832438359|Ohio State]].

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.

stories.h: A raise keeps K.Blackwell at Kentucky despite the losing
stories.d: [[p:557712371|K.Blackwell]] was stuck on a losing team and drew interest. [[t:832438328|Kentucky]] answered by raising his NIL from 130K to 205K. A source says that was enough to end the conversation before it got serious.

quote.text: Once the number came in, it wasn't much of a debate.
quote.by: a source familiar with the talks

stories.h: J.Smith is an 87-overall safety on a backup's salary
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] makes next to nothing in NIL while safeties of his caliber get around 105K. Georgia, with the third-deepest NIL pockets in the country, has reportedly noticed. Rival staffs will pick up the phone if his current team doesn't act.

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Utah clings to five-star D. Iorio as Michigan refuses to fold
stories.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] still holds the lead for [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]], but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has kept working and Indiana is hovering. Iorio's dealbreaker is playing style, and that is where the Wolverines think they can steal him.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to how they'd use him. That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Texas holds a sliver of an edge on Q. Vigil, but Oregon won't back off
stories.d: [[r:561119306|Q. Vigil]] says conference prestige will decide it, and Texas and Oregon are pitching accordingly. Pittsburgh is a distant third but still calling. Both staffs are expected to push hard this week.

quote.text: He wants to know where he'll be playing on Saturdays against the best. Both schools have an answer.

stories.h: Minnesota has the lead on D. Crumpler, but Washington is making up ground
stories.d: [[r:561121033|D. Crumpler]] wants a clear path to playing time, and Minnesota has been the staff to show him one. Washington is pushing back, Indiana is still in the mix, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.

stories.h: Michigan barely leads Notre Dame for R. Kashama, and home is the tiebreaker
stories.d: [[r:561123617|R. Kashama]] has put proximity to home at the top of his list, and the gap between [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and Notre Dame is razor thin. One strong week from either staff could end it.

quote.text: His mom wants him within driving distance. That's been the quiet factor all along.
quote.by: a source close to the family

stories.h: Miami adds four-star athlete T. Lefotu, and the Ohio State win helped
stories.d: [[r:561121658|T. Lefotu]] wanted a bigger stage, and [[t:832438337|Miami]] is on one after beating No. 2 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, the win helped close the deal.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: J. Petty chooses Texas Tech over Indiana, citing the Big 12 and a short path to playing time
stories.d: [[r:561125382|J. Petty]] wanted a power-conference stage and a quick route to the field. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] offered both, with just two defensive tackles returning. Indiana came up short.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Oklahoma lands HB B. Perkins, and NIL and TV exposure carried the day
stories.d: [[r:561123536|B. Perkins]] came in with a reported $270K asking price and wanted maximum exposure. [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], 9th in NIL spending, met both demands, according to a source close to the program.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Tennessee's title pitch works again: four-star WR Z. Cook is a Vol
stories.d: [[r:561124786|Z. Cook]] wanted a real shot at a national title, and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] sold him on it. With just three receivers returning, he can see the field fast. This is another sign the Asiodu momentum is carrying over.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Texas gets WR T. Cobb with a promise of early playing time
stories.d: [[r:561124273|T. Cobb]] sees a receiver room with only four returners and wants to start right away. [[t:832438384|Texas]] is coming off a win over No. 25 [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] and recruiting with confidence.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Texas Tech keeps edge T. Guy in-state, ahead of Kansas State and Utah
stories.d: [[r:561124099|T. Guy]] never seriously considered leaving Texas, and with five edge rushers returning, [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] gave him a clear path to early snaps. Kansas State and [[t:832438400|Utah]] weren't able to move him.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: Miami, Georgia and Missouri are all in on HB K. Kane, with playing time the key
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slimmest lead for [[r:561125249|K. Kane]], with [[t:832438312|Georgia]] right behind and Missouri not far back. He wants to know where he'll carry the ball, and one strong week could decide it.

quote.text: He's asking every staff the same question: when do I play?
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: East Carolina lands two-star center F. Ryland, and H0ldStillPlease closed it personally
stories.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] made the final push for [[r:561123819|F. Ryland]], pitching a depth chart with only two centers returning. [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] is looking to patch the interior after a heavy offseason of losses.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: Clemson gets four-star D. Worley by selling him on the NFL pipeline
stories.d: [[r:561124318|D. Worley]] wants to play on Sundays, and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has a record of producing linebackers who do. With just three linebackers returning, he could be on the field early.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: Tennessee adds four-star HB L. Wood, who trusted the staff's résumé
stories.d: [[r:561122217|L. Wood]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] because of its coaches, and sources say that credibility mattered more to him than any other pitch. It was a second big win for the Vols this week.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.

stories.h: Alabama gets WR P. Hyde, and the NIL machine is rolling again
stories.d: [[r:561120814|P. Hyde]] reportedly wanted $270K and a national spotlight. [[t:832438274|Alabama]], 6th in NIL spending, delivered on both. Rival staffs are asking whether anyone can match that kind of offer.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: D. Leake leaves home for Texas A&M, and power-conference status won out
stories.d: [[r:561124975|D. Leake]] had said staying close to home was a dealbreaker, yet he picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] across the country. A source says conference prestige was too strong to pass up.

quote.text: It was hard to leave home, but this is about my future.

stories.h: It was never close: I. Woodhead picks Indiana and its title push
stories.d: [[r:561119887|I. Woodhead]] wanted to play for a contender, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] convinced him quickly. The Hoosiers' record of getting running backs to the league only strengthened the case.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: I. Obidegwu stays at Oregon after a month on Portal Watch
stories.d: [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]] sat on the list for four weeks as a questionable scheme fit. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438364|Oregon]] roster. A raise in NIL, from 155K to 195K, seems to have helped.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Texas Tech keeps buried Q. Joyner with a pay bump
stories.d: [[p:557717144|Q.Joyner]] was stuck on the depth chart, but [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] raised his NIL from 110K to 145K, and he is still on the roster with the portal open.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Smith stays at Georgia despite a stretch on the watch list
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] spent three weeks on Portal Watch, in part for being underpaid. The portal is open, but he is still a Bulldog.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: C. Gooden stays at Colorado after a raise from nothing
stories.d: [[p:557715427|C.Gooden]] was a scheme-fit concern on Portal Watch, but [[t:832438295|Colorado]] moved his NIL from 0K to 65K, and he's staying.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: L. Bey is a backfield weapon in an Ohio State offense that doesn't throw to backs
stories.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]], an 87-overall back, plays for a team ranked 121st of 138 in receptions. After the roster turnover in Columbus, Tuddy_roosevelt may have to convince him to stay.

quote.text: Guys like that look at how they're being used, and then they start taking calls.
quote.by: an agent familiar with the market

stories.h: J. Mbatchou is playing for nothing. Florida is one team that could change that
stories.d: [[p:557718302|J.Mbatchou]] is an 85-overall defensive tackle with no NIL deal, while comparable players command around 105K. Per one source, [[t:832438308|Florida]] has been mentioned by agents as a suitor with the cash to close that gap.

quote.text: A guy rated like that doesn't stay unpaid once the portal calls start.
quote.by: an agent who works with SEC players

stories.h: A. Rowden is a bargain at Texas Tech, and rivals know it
stories.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is an 84-overall running back who makes nothing in NIL, while players like him get around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has deep pockets, which is the only reason that gap hasn't already cost them.

quote.text: If I'm his agent, I'm making calls this week.

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling James Madison's K. Billiot
stories.d: [[p:557723756|K.Billiot]] is an 86-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while his peers get around 90K. [[t:832438323|James Madison]] ranks 80th in NIL spending and isn't built for a bidding war. Several bigger collectives are reportedly aware of the gap.

quote.text: You can't pay him what the big boys will. That's just reality.
quote.by: a source familiar with JMU's NIL operation

stories.h: C. Knighten is No. 2 on East Carolina's depth chart and may look elsewhere
stories.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] is an 81-overall junior back with just three snaps in 12 games. [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] and Pirate_flag could lose him to a team that would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: A guy like that is waiting for an opportunity to play, and a lot of teams would give it to him.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: K. Mothudi is too good to sit. A transfer looks likely
stories.d: [[p:557719085|K.Mothudi]] is an 84-overall junior middle linebacker who played just 86 snaps in 13 games. Staffs in the portal market have noticed, and one told us he would start for them tomorrow.

quote.text: He's a starter everywhere but where he is.

stories.h: K. Blackwell is wasted on a 4-8 Kentucky team and could be the portal's top prize
stories.d: [[p:557712371|K.Blackwell]] is an 88-overall junior cornerback stuck on a Kentucky team that finished 4-8. If he enters the portal, he'd be the story of the offseason. Contenders needing secondary help are said to be waiting.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at corner has his number written down.

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.41 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Ohio State's Portal Floodgates Open: 19 Gone, Two Five-Star Receivers Among Them
stories.d: Chris Henry Jr. and Jerquaden Guilford, both five-star receivers, are in the portal along with quarterback Tavien St. Clair and 16 others. Tuddy_roosevelt now has 14 four- and five-star holes to fill at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]].

quote.text: Nobody in that building thought it would be this many. It felt like everybody had been waiting for someone else to go first.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: Penn State Sheds 13 Players, but the Names Hurt More Than the Count
stories.d: Cornerback Jahmir Joseph, quarterback Christian Flanagan and tackle Owen Aliciene lead the group leaving [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. Agerm40 can say the bleeding is limited, but he loses a starter-caliber piece in the secondary, at quarterback and on the line.

quote.text: They'll tell you it's just the normal churn. It doesn't feel normal when your corner and your QB are both in the portal.

stories.h: East Carolina Quietly Loses 12, Led by Edge Rusher Ethan Wilson
stories.d: Wilson, running back Ashton Gray and receiver Donnell Mitchell are among the 12 players who left [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] for the portal. It's no Ohio State-sized exodus, but Pirate_flag will feel it on the edge.

quote.text: Wilson was the one other staffs actually asked about. He's going to have plenty of options.
quote.by: a Group of Five assistant coach

stories.h: I.West Exits Ohio State After Four Weeks Stuck on the Depth Chart
stories.d: TD Wire flagged [[p:557722831|I.West]] for a month as a player buried at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. He's now in the portal. The only surprise is how long he waited.

quote.text: He wanted to play. He was tired of being told next year.

stories.h: D.Jones Leaves Ohio State's Crowded Depth Chart for the Portal
stories.d: [[p:557727811|D.Jones]] had been on TD Wire's watch list for two weeks as a buried player. He's now in the portal, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s room is thinner for it.

quote.text: When you see the guys in front of you aren't going anywhere, you start making calls.
quote.by: a source familiar with Jones' thinking

stories.h: J.Joseph's Exit Raises Questions About Penn State's Defensive Fit
stories.d: Poor scheme fit was the warning sign on [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] for three weeks, and now the cornerback is in the portal. Agerm40's secondary was already a storyline at [[t:832438366|Penn State]].

quote.text: He never felt comfortable in what they asked him to do. That's not a secret inside the building.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

stories.h: C.Flanagan Is Gone From Penn State Just as His Price Climbs
stories.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] was on the watch list for only a week after a rating jump made him pricey. Now the quarterback is in the portal, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has a hole at the position.

quote.text: A bump like that changes the conversation. Every QB-needy school is going to want to know what he costs.
