stories.h: L.Andrews Becomes Another Penn State Scheme Casualty
stories.d: [[p:557723610|L.Andrews]] was flagged a week ago as a bad fit, and now he's in the portal. He joins J.Joseph in leaving [[t:832438366|Penn State]], which raises the question of what's going on with the fit.

stories.h: T.St. Clair Leaves Ohio State After a Rough Stretch of Numbers
stories.d: [[p:557721477|T.St. Clair]] was under fire for his production, and the quarterback is now in the portal. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has to answer for another departure at the most scrutinized position on the roster.

quote.text: The production wasn't where he wanted it. He's looking for a place that gives him a clean slate.
quote.by: a source close to the quarterback

stories.h: Buried on the depth chart, A.Rogers is still at Ohio State
stories.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] sat on Portal Watch for 5 weeks as one of our likeliest departures. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff apparently had a better pitch than the depth chart.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: B.Riker passes on the portal despite feeling underpaid at Penn State
stories.d: [[p:557720389|B.Riker]] looked like a classic underpaid-for-his-rating case, and three weeks of Portal Watch heat didn't move him. He remains on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, a small win for agerm40.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: Tennessee talks Q.Porter out of the portal with a bigger NIL deal
stories.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]] was buried on the depth chart, took heat for his numbers and looked gone. The [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] staff raised his NIL from 160K to 190K, and he's still on the roster.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.

stories.h: Michigan State keeps D.Olugbode after six weeks of departure chatter
stories.d: Losing wore on [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]], and rival staffs were reportedly circling. [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] raised his NIL from 230K to 285K and he's staying. Spartans fans will take any win right now.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Michigan paid to keep S.Hiter, and it was closer than expected
stories.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]] spent six weeks as one of the portal's most obvious flight risks on a losing team. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] raised his NIL from 115K to 195K, and he's still in Ann Arbor. Other staffs had reportedly made contact.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a person with knowledge of the talks

stories.h: J.Zayas stays at Penn State, easing worries in agerm40's secondary
stories.d: Scheme-fit questions had [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] on Portal Watch for three weeks. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, which matters for a secondary already under scrutiny.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: N.Pullard's rating jump didn't pry him away from Penn State
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] was about to get expensive after a rating jump, which usually invites calls. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, and agerm40's staff gets credit for keeping him in the loop.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State holds on to J.Blue after his rating jump
stories.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] hit Portal Watch for a week after a rating jump made him an expensive keeper. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Tuddy_roosevelt can exhale on this one.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: S.Boyce never seriously considered leaving Ohio State, sources say
stories.d: The rating jump put [[p:557714154|S.Boyce]] on Portal Watch, but the portal opened and he's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. People close to the situation say the outside noise was louder than the reality.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Oregon keeps D.Moore, a surprise given his pay and scheme fit
stories.d: [[p:557718955|D.Moore]] was underpaid for his rating, a poor scheme fit, and a likely departure. He's still on the [[t:832438364|Oregon]] roster. That answers one question for a Ducks program with a leaky pass defense.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.

stories.h: Utah Holds the Edge on Iorio, but Michigan Refuses to Fold
stories.d: Utah is still in front for five-star [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]], but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has kept pushing. Indiana is lurking, and the fight appears to be about how he wants to play.

quote.text: He keeps asking one thing: where does he get to play his style of football?
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: LSU's Championship Pitch Is Putting Real Heat on SMU for Egan
stories.d: SMU still has the lead for [[r:561119612|C. Egan]], but [[t:832438333|LSU]] sells the title-contender story he says he wants. Memphis is hanging around, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to win it all. LSU keeps saying that out loud, and he's listening.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: Florida State Clings to Lead for Melton as Tennessee Pushes
stories.d: Florida State is ahead for [[r:561123778|C. Melton]], but Tennessee is close and Michigan State is still in the mix. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and one more good week for the Seminoles might end it.

quote.text: He wants to see a real path to the field. Whoever shows it wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Army, Minnesota and Penn State All Want Holly. Only One Gets Him
stories.d: Army has a thin lead for [[r:561124180|P. Holly]], with Minnesota right there and Penn State close enough to matter. Playing time drives his decision, and a wide-open receiver room gives each school a pitch.

quote.text: Every staff is telling him he'll play early. He's trying to figure out who means it.

stories.h: Texas A&M Keeps a Four-Star Safety Home With Hack Pledge
stories.d: [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] landed four-star safety [[r:561123994|J. Hack]], who gets power-conference football without leaving Texas. His parents can be at every home game.

quote.text: I want to test myself against the best, and I get to do it in front of my family.

stories.h: Indiana Adds Four-Star Receiver Bighill, and the Pro Pitch Worked
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed four-star receiver [[r:561122973|C. Bighill]]. The Hoosiers sold power-conference football and a track record of sending receivers to the NFL, including two in the first round.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. Receivers leave there and get picked.

stories.h: D.Moore Is a 95-Overall Receiver With No NIL Deal. Oregon Should Worry
stories.d: [[p:557718955|D.Moore]] is playing like one of the best receivers in the country and earning nothing in NIL. Oregon's collective is among the richest, but rivals know the market price at his position is far higher.

quote.text: Everybody's talking about it. Players that good don't stay unpaid long.
quote.by: an agent who works with college players

stories.h: Will Washington Be the Team That Pays D.Roebuck?
stories.d: [[p:557720542|D.Roebuck]] is a 94-overall receiver earning nothing in NIL, and that mismatch rarely lasts once the portal opens. [[t:832438408|Washington]] is the name some collectives keep bringing up.

quote.text: Somebody will make him an offer he can't ignore. It's just a matter of who.

stories.h: Miami Has a Bargain in Pringle Jr. for Now
stories.d: [[p:557720030|G.Pringle Jr.]] is a 91-overall back making nothing in NIL. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the money to fix that, but rival collectives are already doing the math on what he'd cost.

quote.text: If Miami doesn't take care of him, somebody else will.
quote.by: a source close to a rival collective

stories.h: Rival Collectives Are Circling Clemson's G.Davidson
stories.d: [[p:557714033|G.Davidson]] is a 92-overall back with no NIL money, and other programs have noticed. [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has deep pockets, but the Tigers are also dealing with portal rumors elsewhere on the roster.

quote.text: Backs like that don't last. Some collectives already have his number.

stories.h: A.Rogers Is Too Good to Sit, and Portal Suitors Know It
stories.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]], an 84-overall junior back, has barely played. Portal teams see a starter, and a source says he's asking whether his future is elsewhere.

quote.text: He's a guy who should be playing. He knows it and so does his camp.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Stuck at No. 4 on Tennessee's Depth Chart, Q.Porter May Not Wait
stories.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]] is a 90-overall junior receiver who would start for most programs. At Tennessee he's fourth on the chart, and several portal suitors are already interested.

quote.text: He's too talented to be fourth. Half the league would start him tomorrow.

stories.h: Oregon's Struggling Pass Defense Could Push Obidegwu Toward the Portal
stories.d: Oregon ranks 128th of 138 in pass defense, and [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]], an 89-overall field corner, may want out. The portal could be the way, and the Ducks' recruiting pitch on defense could take a hit.

quote.text: Corners that good want to play in a system that protects them.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

stories.h: Q.Joyner Is Too Good to Sit. A Transfer May Be Coming
stories.d: [[p:557717144|Q.Joyner]] is an 88-overall sophomore back who has barely played. Portal teams would hand him the job, and the lack of carries could lead to a transfer.

quote.text: He's patient but he isn't blind. He wants a real role.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: Is LSU Ready to Move On From D.Jones?
stories.d: [[p:557717043|D.Jones]] averaged just 3.3 yards a carry, which is hard to justify for an 85-overall back on a ranked team. [[t:832438333|LSU]]'s staff faces a decision before next season, and the portal is an obvious way to answer it.

quote.text: They expected more. They'll look for it if they don't get it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: R.Marriott Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Disagree
stories.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]], an 86-overall quarterback, threw 13 touchdowns against 14 interceptions. His staff may look at other options in the portal, and that could set off a chain reaction at the position.

quote.text: It isn't what anyone expected. They're going to look around.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ratings Say 86. J.Washington's Stat Sheet Says Something Else
stories.d: [[p:557722672|J.Washington]] ran for 421 yards on 106 carries, an unremarkable 4.0 per carry for an 86-overall back. The staff has a decision to make before next season, and the portal is an option.

quote.text: The talent is there. The production just hasn't matched it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $1.75 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Utah holds the edge for D. Iorio, but Michigan won't back off
stories.d: [[t:832438400|Utah]] has the lead for five-star SAM [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]]. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] is still pushing, and Indiana is hanging around. Playing style is his dealbreaker, and that's where the pitches are being made.

quote.text: He keeps asking how he'd be used, not what the facilities look like. That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Florida State leads for D. Calvin, but Utah is pushing back
stories.d: [[t:832438310|Florida State]] has the edge for four-star C [[r:561123531|D. Calvin]]. [[t:832438400|Utah]] hasn't folded, and Boise State is still in the mix. Playing style is the dealbreaker, so the next conversations with position coaches could matter most.

quote.text: Nobody's out of it. He wants to hear exactly how the offense will run through the middle.
quote.by: a person familiar with Calvin's thinking

stories.h: SMU leads for C. Egan, but LSU's title pitch has teeth
stories.d: [[t:832438375|SMU]] is ahead for [[r:561119612|C. Egan]], with Memphis a distant third. His dealbreaker is a championship contender, and [[t:832438333|LSU]] grades out best there. Official visits could decide it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to wanting a real shot at a ring. LSU knows that and is leaning on it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Army, Minnesota and Penn State are all circling P. Holly
stories.d: [[t:832438280|Army]] has a slim lead for [[r:561124180|P. Holly]], and Minnesota is right behind. Penn State is lurking too. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and with [[p:557711608|B.Anderson]] out of eligibility after this season, Army's receiver room is wide open.

quote.text: He's reading depth charts like box scores. Whoever shows him the fastest path to the field gets him.

stories.h: Georgia lands WR J. Cassidy, who sees an early path to playing
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] picked up four-star WR [[r:561122828|J. Cassidy]] from Jacksonville. [[p:557713174|I.Canion]] is out of eligibility after this season, which leaves the Bulldogs' receiver room wide open. Georgia's staff needed a win on the trail.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Oklahoma City's D. Baker picks SMU, and the Sooners feel it
stories.d: Four-star TE [[r:561121725|D. Baker]] is staying in the region and committing to [[t:832438375|SMU]]. The Mustangs sold him on conference prestige and a short trip home. Oklahoma will notice losing a local kid.

quote.text: I'm representing Oklahoma City. Staying close was always the plan.

stories.h: Notre Dame's DB pipeline lands four-star SS B. Murphey
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] added four-star SS [[r:561123185|B. Murphey]]. The Irish lead the nation in pro potential at defensive back, with five draft picks there in four years, and they're 11-2 and ranked No. 6. Murphey's camp was impressed by the draft board.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

stories.h: Tennessee gets C. Poe, and his mom gets Saturdays
stories.d: Four-star MIKE [[r:561124407|C. Poe]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] over the other programs after his home visits. The Vols are 11-3 and ranked No. 12, and Virginia Beach is a short drive from Knoxville. The winning and the proximity both mattered.

quote.text: My mom gets to see me play every Saturday. That was huge for me.

stories.h: Hometown safety O. Hoppes gives East Carolina a win
stories.d: One-star FS [[r:561124684|O. Hoppes]] is staying in North Carolina and committing to [[t:832438301|East Carolina]]. His parents will make every home game, and with [[p:557727961|T.Love]] and [[p:557719784|C.Peterson]] out of eligibility after this season, the safety room has room for him. Pirate_flag takes it.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. East Carolina just felt like family.

stories.h: Oregon State's patience with B.Atkinson may be wearing thin
stories.d: [[p:557711762|B.Atkinson]] has thrown for 3229 yards, 17 touchdowns and 7 picks with a 133.9 rating. That isn't good enough for a 90-overall quarterback at [[t:832438365|Oregon State]]. Another rough month and the questions get louder.

quote.text: Nobody's panicking, but the staff expected more from him. People are paying attention.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: D. Olugbode Deserves Better Than 4-9. Contenders Will Be Calling
stories.d: [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]] is a 92-overall junior receiver on a Michigan State team that's 4-9. If he enters the portal, it becomes the story of the offseason. Per a source, several contenders are already preparing offers.

quote.text: A talent like that on a team like that? Everyone's watching.

stories.h: A.Marsh is wasted on a 4-8 TCU team, and rivals know it
stories.d: [[p:557718144|A.Marsh]] is a 91-overall junior receiver on a TCU team that finished 4-8. If he reaches the portal, he becomes the story of the offseason. Contenders have already noticed.

quote.text: If he's out there, every contender will be calling within the hour.

stories.h: S.Hiter deserves better than 2-10, and contenders will call
stories.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]] is a 90-overall sophomore running back stuck on a [[t:832438339|Michigan]] team that finished 2-10. If he hits the portal, he becomes the story of the offseason. Contenders are already doing their homework.

quote.text: You don't find backs like that on a team that bad. Staffs are already making their lists.

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $2 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557726016|K.Ryan]]: 85K to 345K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Nebraska holds a slim edge over LSU for J. Tyree, but snaps are the key
stories.d: Nebraska has the slight lead for [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]], LSU is right behind, and Georgia is lurking. Tyree has told people close to him that playing time is the dealbreaker, so both staffs are expected to pitch him a depth chart.

quote.text: He wants to see a real path to the field. Whoever shows him that wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Utah clings to a lead for five-star D. Iorio as Michigan pushes back
stories.d: Utah is ahead for SAM [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]], but Michigan has stayed in the race and Indiana has been making calls. Playing style is his dealbreaker, and the Utes' pitch has landed well.

quote.text: He wants to be used in space, not parked in a box.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: SMU leads, but Utah is crashing the party for five-star C. Virgin
stories.d: SMU has a slim edge for ATH [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]], with Notre Dame close and Utah right there too. Playing time is the dealbreaker. One rival staffer said Virgin is "looking at depth charts more than logos."

quote.text: He keeps asking the same question: when do I get on the field?

stories.h: Utah holds edge for Calvin, but Florida State isn't backing off
stories.d: The four-star center wants a certain style of play, and the Utes have the early lead. Florida State has kept pushing, and Boise State is still in the picture. Utah is already chasing Iorio and Virgin, so this one matters.

quote.text: He keeps asking how they'll actually use him. Whoever answers that best gets him.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Ohio State lands X. Bobo, who wanted the biggest stage
stories.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] gets four-star ATH [[r:561119238|X. Bobo]]. Bobo wanted national exposure, and Ohio State's No. 1 NIL ranking and a reported $285K price tag sealed it. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff pitched him on prime-time TV.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: BYU and UCLA are chasing C. Punga, and Washington is circling
stories.d: BYU has the lead for four-star C [[r:561123261|N. Punga]], while UCLA stays close and Washington lingers. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and a source says that has made this a tough call for him and his family.

quote.text: It's about the league he'll be playing in. That's what he keeps coming back to.
quote.by: a person close to the family

stories.h: SMU leads for Egan, but LSU's title pitch is landing
stories.d: The Mustangs hold the lead for [[r:561119612|C. Egan]], fresh off landing Toviessi. [[t:832438333|LSU]] grades out an A as a championship contender, which is what Egan says he wants. Memphis is lurking, and official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He wants to play for a trophy. LSU knows that, and they're leaning into it hard.

stories.h: No. 2 overall B. Toviessi picks SMU, a win over Oklahoma's surge
stories.d: [[r:561125692|B. Toviessi]] is headed to [[t:832438375|SMU]] after a late stretch of Oklahoma momentum. With [[p:557711627|J.Anderson]] (SR) out of eligibility after this season, the Mustangs have a clear heir in the linebacker room.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: X. Bobo makes it official with Ohio State
stories.d: [[r:561119238|X. Bobo]] signed with [[t:832438359|Ohio State]], and the Buckeyes' prime-time stage was the pitch. A source says the program was never worried he would waver.

stories.h: Georgia beats Ohio State for B. Tippmann, even with home pulling at him
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] lands five-star ATH [[r:561124210|B. Tippmann]], who listed proximity to home as a dealbreaker and still went across the country. A reported $320K price tag and Georgia's No. 2 NIL ranking made it work. Ohio State, with Tuddy_roosevelt in the mix, is left to regroup.

quote.text: It's a business too. They made it make sense.

stories.h: Georgia wins the tug-of-war for FS P. Leber, beating Texas
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] gets five-star FS [[r:561122126|P. Leber]] after a long fight. His reported $385K price tag was met, and Georgia's track record of DBs going to the draft, including one in the first round, made the pitch easy for the staff.

quote.text: He saw four DBs drafted in four years. That was the sell.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Oklahoma gets K. Malchow, who wanted to stay close to Austin
stories.d: [[r:561124997|K. Malchow]] signed with [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], and a short drive from Austin mattered to him and his family. It's another solid piece of the Sooners' recruiting run.

stories.h: B. Toviessi inks with SMU, and a power-conference pitch lands
stories.d: [[t:832438375|SMU]] seals the deal with five-star WILL [[r:561125692|B. Toviessi]]. His camp has said the power-conference stage was the draw. Oklahoma was the main rival, and it was not close at the end, per a source.

quote.text: The conference, the competition, it all lined up.

stories.h: Notre Dame adds M. Newcombe to a receiver room with openings
stories.d: [[r:561124795|M. Newcombe]] signed with [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. With [[p:557715534|J.Greathouse]] (SR) out of eligibility after this season, the Irish have a job to fill, and the staff made sure Newcombe saw the depth chart.

stories.h: Tennessee gets Asiodu with a title-contender pitch
stories.d: [[r:561123170|C. Asiodu]] told people he wanted a real shot at a championship, and [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] gave him one. The Vols' A grade as a contender sealed it, and the staff considers it a statement signing.

quote.text: He looked at the roster and saw a team that can win it all. That settled it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Alabama locks up five-star HB R. Locke
stories.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] seals the deal with five-star HB [[r:561124923|R. Locke]]. He wanted to play in a power conference, and Alabama's A+ conference-prestige grade sold it. A source says the Tide were not worried.

stories.h: Ole Miss keeps G. Banogu home in Mississippi
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] seals the deal with five-star HB [[r:561124079|G. Banogu]], who never seriously considered leaving the state. The Rebels have to like it. A rival staffer said, "Mississippi kids stay in Mississippi."

quote.text: Mississippi kids stay in Mississippi.

stories.h: Notre Dame closes with five-star REDG F. Cutrera
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] seals the deal with five-star REDG [[r:561123430|F. Cutrera]]. A reported $360K price tag and the Irish's No. 8 NIL ranking helped them close. One source says the money talk went smoothly.

stories.h: Tennessee gets C. Provo, who wanted a power conference
stories.d: [[r:561125415|C. Provo]] signed with [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]. Tennessee's A+ conference-prestige grade was the draw. The Volunteers' staff reportedly told him he would get a power-conference stage every week.

stories.h: Georgia's NIL muscle wins Duggan at a reported $420K
stories.d: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] ranks 2nd in NIL spending, and [[r:561120351|J. Duggan]]'s camp wanted a number. The Bulldogs met it. It's another win for a program already hauling in Tippmann and Leber despite its pass-defense troubles.

quote.text: Once the number was there, the conversation was basically over.
quote.by: a person familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: Nebraska signs M. Azumah to fill an athlete hole
stories.d: [[r:561121637|M. Azumah]] signed with [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]. With [[p:557715333|K.Gilmer]] (SR) out of eligibility after this season, the staff has a need to fill. A source says Nebraska has been targeting him all year.

stories.h: Miami adds five-star ATH A. Roche on a title pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] seals the deal with five-star ATH [[r:561122246|A. Roche]], who wanted a shot at a title. Miami's A+ contender grade got it done. A source close to the program called him a priority since spring.

stories.h: Ole Miss gets E. Bush after selling its RB pipeline
stories.d: [[r:561120807|E. Bush]] signed with [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], which ranks 2nd nationally in pro potential at RB, with a first-round pick in the past four years. The Rebels' staff leaned on that all fall, per a source.

stories.h: Oklahoma adds five-star ATH K. Morey, who stayed close to Denton
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] seals the deal with five-star ATH [[r:561119882|K. Morey]]. A short drive from Denton mattered to him, and the Sooners' recent momentum on the trail did not hurt either.

stories.h: C. Christmas picks Notre Dame, lured by a job to compete for
stories.d: [[r:561123998|C. Christmas]] signed with [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. The Irish sold him on competing for a job right away, and he liked that. A source says the staff made a strong impression on his family.

stories.h: Oregon lands Tyms, and sells the title window to do it
stories.d: [[r:561125068|A. Tyms]] wanted a shot at a title, and [[t:832438364|Oregon]]'s A+ grade as a contender was hard to beat. He arrives with the Ducks' pass defense under the microscope, and some in Eugene hope he's part of the fix.

quote.text: He believes they're a title team. The secondary questions didn't scare him off.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Oregon lands R. Wilcox with a pitch of immediate playing time
stories.d: [[r:561125440|R. Wilcox]] signed with [[t:832438364|Oregon]], which sold him on competing for a job right away. A source says Wilcox wanted to see the depth chart before he made a decision.

stories.h: Pittsburgh seals five-star LEDG A. Rugamba
stories.d: [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] seals the deal with five-star LEDG [[r:561120305|A. Rugamba]]. The Panthers sold him on competing for a job right away. It is a splashy get for a program not always in this conversation.

stories.h: Michigan signs J. Lockett, who wanted a power-conference stage
stories.d: [[r:561119775|J. Lockett]] signed with [[t:832438339|Michigan]], which got an A+ for conference prestige. It is some consolation as the Wolverines keep chasing Iorio, per a source.

stories.h: Alabama pays up for five-star edge rusher Hardy
stories.d: [[t:832438274|Alabama]] ranks 3rd in NIL spending, and it showed with [[r:561120345|R. Hardy]], whose asking price was a reported $430K. Rival staffs say the Tide never seemed worried once the money talk began.

quote.text: When Alabama puts that kind of offer on the table, most schools just can't match it.

stories.h: Georgia Beats Ohio State for B. Tippmann, and the Price Was Steep
stories.d: [[r:561124210|B. Tippmann]] is officially a [[t:832438312|Georgia]] Bulldog. A reported $320K ask fit a program that ranks 2nd in NIL spending. Ohio State's Tuddy_roosevelt now has to regroup.

quote.text: Once the money conversation was settled, it wasn't close to being a conversation anymore.
quote.by: a source close to the Georgia program

stories.h: Clemson Locks Up Five-Star Tackle E. Pratt as Burley Era Nears End
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] landed [[r:561124299|E. Pratt]] with [[p:557712989|V.Burley]] set to run out of eligibility after this season. The interior of the Tigers' defensive line is about to belong to a new face.

quote.text: I saw a room with a spot open right away. That mattered to me.

stories.h: Georgia Adds P. Leber, Making Its Weekend Haul Look Easy
stories.d: [[r:561122126|P. Leber]] signs with [[t:832438312|Georgia]] after a reported $385K ask. Texas was in the mix late. Per a source, the Bulldogs' NIL push had the Longhorns playing catch-up.

quote.text: Texas had a good visit. Georgia just had the better offer.
quote.by: a source familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: Alabama adds five-star receiver Mama on another big NIL deal
stories.d: [[r:561122657|D. Mama]] reportedly wanted $390K, and [[t:832438274|Alabama]] got it done. Paired with Hardy, it's a haul that has other SEC staffs wondering how to keep up.

quote.text: Their NIL pitch is just different from everyone else's right now.

stories.h: Miami Turns Win Over Ohio State Into Five-Star Corner A. Leamon
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] took down then-No. 2 [[t:832438359|Ohio State]], then watched [[r:561119712|A. Leamon]] sign. Staffers say the timing was no accident. The Hurricanes used the upset as their closing argument.

quote.text: Beating Ohio State changed the tone of the whole conversation.
quote.by: a source close to the Miami program

stories.h: Oklahoma Signs J. Barkow With the Promise of Real Playing Time
stories.d: [[r:561123500|J. Barkow]] is a [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] receiver after being sold on competing right away. The Sooners keep winning recruiting battles, and the proximity to Texas talent keeps showing.

quote.text: They told me I'd get a shot on day one. That's all I asked for.

stories.h: LSU Signs J. Kirkendoll to Replace Elzy's Production at Receiver
stories.d: [[r:561121905|J. Kirkendoll]] arrives at [[t:832438333|LSU]] just as [[p:557724385|M.Elzy]] heads toward the end of his eligibility. The Tigers needed a long-term answer. Staffers like what they saw.

quote.text: The depth chart opens up fast there. He saw it right away.
quote.by: a high school coach familiar with the recruitment

stories.h: Reinbolt picks Alabama for the staff, not just the money
stories.d: Unlike Hardy and Mama, [[r:561124450|A. Reinbolt]] cared most about the coaches. [[t:832438274|Alabama]] grades out an A in coach prestige, and people close to him say the staff's presence on his visit made the difference.

quote.text: He felt like the coaches were genuinely invested in him. That was the thing.

stories.h: Oklahoma Lands Five-Star Edge G. Feeney as Wein Exits
stories.d: [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] sealed [[r:561120370|G. Feeney]], and the timing is perfect. [[p:557722792|T.Wein]] runs out of eligibility after this season. Feeney's arrival feels like a planned handoff at edge rusher.

stories.h: Notre Dame's Linebacker Pipeline Wins Again With H. Wonnum
stories.d: [[r:561125329|H. Wonnum]] signs with [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], whose record of producing draft picks at linebacker closed it. The Irish haul keeps growing as they chase Virgin.

quote.text: He looked at where those linebackers end up. The pitch was easy.
quote.by: a source close to the Notre Dame program

stories.h: Rival Collectives Circle Washington Star D. Roebuck
stories.d: [[p:557720542|D.Roebuck]] is a 94-overall receiver earning nothing in NIL while comparable players command around 285K. Rival collectives have noticed. Per a source, a few have already put numbers on paper.

quote.text: A guy like that doesn't stay unpaid. Somebody will make it hard to say no.

stories.h: G. Pringle Jr. Plays Like a Star, Gets Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557720030|G.Pringle Jr.]] is a 91-overall back making nothing in NIL, while comparable players command around 210K. [[t:832438337|Miami]]'s deep pockets make the Hurricanes a natural landing spot if he hits the portal.

quote.text: Miami has the money and a reason to use it.

stories.h: Will Clemson Be the One to Back the Truck Up for G. Davidson?
stories.d: [[p:557714033|G.Davidson]] is a 92-overall back making nothing while the market sits around 215K. [[t:832438293|Clemson]] has the NIL muscle (6th nationally). Don't be surprised if the Tigers make a call.

stories.h: K. Miller Is a Bargain for USC. That Won't Last Long
stories.d: [[p:557718778|K.Miller]] is a 91-overall running back earning nothing at [[t:832438398|USC]], and the market says around 210K. Other programs will notice. Expect a lot of calls once the portal opens.

quote.text: You don't get a back like that for free for long.

stories.h: Freshman Corner N. Pullard Is Rising Fast at Penn State
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] jumped to 79 overall, up 4 points in a week, and now earns 60K. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has the NIL room (9th nationally) to keep him. Agerm40 can use him as a development pitch to Q. Vigil.

quote.text: Guys that young don't usually grow like that. The staff is thrilled.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

stories.h: Whispers Grow About T. St. Clair at Ohio State After Miami Loss
stories.d: [[p:557721477|T.St. Clair]] has thrown 42 touchdowns against 8 interceptions, but the whispers persist at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Another rough month would turn them into a roar. Tuddy_roosevelt faces a real decision.

quote.text: The numbers are fine. The expectations are bigger than fine.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: Ohio State's J. Blue Rises to 76 Overall at Corner
stories.d: [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] is up 3 points and earning 110K. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s NIL room (1st nationally) means Tuddy_roosevelt can keep him. After the Miami loss, the Buckeyes need young defensive backs to grow.

stories.h: Guard S. Boyce Is Climbing at Ohio State, and the Staff Has Noticed
stories.d: [[p:557714154|S.Boyce]] has jumped to 75 overall and earns 55K. Per a source, [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] sees him as a long-term piece on the interior line. The 1st-ranked NIL budget makes a raise easy.

quote.text: He's earning every snap. The staff talks about him constantly.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: Freshman QB C. Flanagan Is Already Paid Well Above Market at Penn State
stories.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] jumped to 79 overall and earns 240K, while quarterbacks rated around 79 draw a median of 45K across FBS. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] clearly values him. Agerm40 is paying for the future.

quote.text: That number tells you how Penn State sees him.

stories.h: Penn State's leaky secondary could push Joseph toward the portal
stories.d: [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 126th of 138 in pass defense, a rough landing spot for 83-overall corner [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]]. Agerm40's team is winning, but players in the secondary reportedly want to know what the fix is.

quote.text: Guys want to be in a system that helps them. Right now it's a fair question.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Zayas is another Penn State corner who could test the market
stories.d: Another Nittany Lions defensive back may be eyeing the exits. [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 82-overall corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] pass defense that ranks 126th of 138. If he and Joseph both leave, it's a real problem for Agerm40.

quote.text: If one of them leaves, the other one is likely thinking about it too.

stories.h: I. West Is Too Good to Sit. Is a Transfer Coming?
stories.d: [[p:557722831|I.West]] is an 85-overall sophomore running back with just 114 snaps in 16 games. Someone in the portal would start him tomorrow, and he knows it.

quote.text: He's frustrated. He thinks he's earned more than this.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: UCLA Freshman K. Moore III Hits 87 Overall and Isn't Paid Yet
stories.d: [[p:557725526|K.Moore III]] is up 3 points and earning nothing in NIL. [[t:832438394|UCLA]] has the pockets (13th nationally) to fix that fast. Rival staffs aren't waiting.

quote.text: A freshman at that rating earning nothing? Someone's going to call.

stories.h: Stuck Fourth at Running Back, A. Rogers Might Leave Ohio State
stories.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] is an 84-overall junior with 78 snaps in 16 games. Per a source, he's frustrated with Tuddy_roosevelt's depth chart. A running back room at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] that crowded can cost you someone good.

quote.text: He's a starter somewhere. He knows that.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: D. Jones Is Too Good to Sit. Is He Heading to the Portal?
stories.d: [[p:557727811|D.Jones]] is an 84-overall junior receiver with 235 snaps in 16 games. A starting job is waiting for him in the portal. Staffers elsewhere are already tracking him.

quote.text: He's ready to be the guy. Eventually he'll want to be it somewhere.

stories.h: Georgia's pass defense could cost it star corner Robinson
stories.d: [[p:557720462|E.Robinson IV]] is a 97-overall bump-and-run corner on a [[t:832438312|Georgia]] defense ranked 136th of 138 against the pass. Programs that need a star corner will call. Georgia's recruiting hot streak could take a hit if he goes.

quote.text: A guy that good, on that defense? Everybody's going to call him.
quote.by: a portal-focused staffer at a rival school

stories.h: K.Henderson Has Numbers, But Not the Star Turn His Rating Promised
stories.d: [[p:557724785|K.Henderson]] has thrown for 3453 yards and 28 touchdowns, yet the staff expected a star from an 89-overall quarterback. Sources say the offseason quarterback conversation has already started inside the building.

quote.text: The production is fine. Nobody here thinks fine is what we signed up for.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: D.Knight's Rating Says 89. His Stat Sheet Says Something Else
stories.d: [[p:557717397|D.Knight]] has thrown 12 interceptions while completing 268 of 447 passes, and a 141.6 rating doesn't fit a ranked team's franchise quarterback. Another rough month and the questions about his job will get louder.

quote.text: You can live with the incompletions. The picks are what get people talking in the booster box.

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $2 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557726016|K.Ryan]]: 85K to 345K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: [[t:832438343|Mississippi State]] stuns No. 10 [[t:832438312|Georgia]] in a shootout, 45-38
stories.d: Mississippi State outgained the Bulldogs 612 to 552 and left Georgia's playoff hopes in pieces. A Georgia source says the postgame locker room was 'dead quiet' and the defense took it hardest.

quote.text: We got outcoached and outplayed on the back end. That's on all of us.
quote.by: a source close to the Georgia program

stories.h: [[p:557712566|R.Clay]] is closing in on the NCAA field goal record
stories.d: With 21 made field goals through nine games, Clay is 10 shy of Billy Bennett's mark of 31, set at Georgia in 2003. At his current pace he would land right around it. One staffer says offenses are now content to stall inside the 30.

quote.text: Honestly, if we cross midfield, he's money. Coaches know it.

stories.h: [[p:557725041|R.Jones]] is on a record-setting pace and defenses know it
stories.d: R.Jones has 1,361 receiving yards through eight games, 699 shy of Trevor Insley's 2,060 from Nevada in 1999. His pace would shatter the record, and one rival coordinator says every week is a new bracket plan.

quote.text: You can't hide a corner on him. We game-planned for him all week and still got burned.

stories.h: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] storms back from a 10-point deficit and stuns [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]
stories.d: Nebraska led 31-21 after three quarters and then watched Minnesota win the fourth 21-0 for a 42-31 final. Per a source, the Huskers' sideline got tense as the lead evaporated.

quote.text: Guys stopped talking on the sideline. You could feel it slipping.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

stories.h: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] falls to [[t:832438309|Florida Atlantic]] in overtime, 38-28
stories.d: Regulation couldn't separate them, but the extra period went the Owls' way. Pirate_flag now has another tough one to answer for, just a week after the quarterback questions from the five-interception loss.

quote.text: We had it. We just didn't finish. That's what keeps coaches up at night.
quote.by: a source close to the East Carolina program

stories.h: [[p:557726977|D.Bell]] shreds [[t:832438293|Clemson]] for 415 yards and five touchdowns
stories.d: Bell went 37-of-47 without a pick as Miami won 38-22. A Clemson defensive source says the Tigers 'had no answer' for the underneath stuff, and the staff is likely to hear about it after last week's 39-38 comeback escape.

quote.text: He was calm all day. Every read was right.

stories.h: [[t:832438410|West Virginia]] goes 0-for-4 on fourth down and the fans are furious
stories.d: The Mountaineers turned it over on downs four times in the loss to [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. Message boards are fuming over the aggression, and a source says some boosters are already asking questions.

quote.text: You can't keep giving a team the ball back like that and expect to win.

stories.h: [[t:832438394|UCLA]] goes 4-for-4 on fourth down and takes down [[t:832438364|Oregon]]
stories.d: UCLA kept its offense on the field every time and every conversion shifted momentum. A Bruins source said the plan was set before kickoff: 'We're not punting in the red zone.'

quote.text: Coach told us on Wednesday we were going. Nobody blinked.

stories.h: [[p:557721882|K.Taylor]] torches [[t:832438312|Georgia]] for 409 yards and four touchdowns
stories.d: Taylor went 31-of-45 with one interception in the 45-38 Mississippi State win. The Georgia secondary got picked apart all day and scouts are noticing. A rival recruiter says Georgia's defense suddenly looks like a pitch point for Texas.

quote.text: Taylor just kept finding the soft spot. Georgia couldn't get off the field.

stories.h: [[p:557711606|L.Anderson III]] throws three picks as [[t:832438377|South Carolina]] falls to [[t:832438344|Missouri]]
stories.d: Anderson finished 15-of-29 for 201 yards and a touchdown, but the three interceptions did the damage. One source says the quarterback stayed late at the facility after the loss to watch film alone.

quote.text: He knows he forced it. He's hard on himself.
quote.by: a source close to the South Carolina program

stories.h: [[p:557727038|F.Brandon]] puts up 434 yards as Tennessee beats [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]]
stories.d: Brandon went 29-of-43 with four touchdowns and no interceptions in the 35-23 win. Oklahoma's secondary is hearing it, and with the fight for WILL B. Toviessi heating up, a rival recruiter says the loss could 'hurt the pitch.'

quote.text: They couldn't cover our guys, plain and simple.

stories.h: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] keeps the trophy with a 45-35 win over [[t:832438346|Navy]]
stories.d: The Irish owned the rivalry again and Navy's staff will have to answer for the defensive lapses. A source close to the Navy program called the loss 'a gut punch' after a strong week of preparation.

quote.text: We had them where we wanted them. We just couldn't stop the big plays.
quote.by: a source close to the Navy program

stories.h: [[t:832438288|BYU]] takes the Holy War in a one-sided rivalry win
stories.d: BYU has bragging rights for another year after a game that was never close. A Utah booster says patience is thinning and the program 'needs answers,' though no change is expected.

quote.text: This was supposed to be the game we circled. It wasn't even competitive.

stories.h: [[p:557715753|W.Hammond]] drops 432 yards on [[t:832438317|Houston]] as Texas Tech cruises, 52-34
stories.d: Hammond went 32-of-47 with three touchdowns and no turnovers. Houston's staff, per a source, feels the defense 'lost the plot' on third down as Texas Tech dictated the pace.

quote.text: Hammond was surgical. We couldn't touch him.
quote.by: a source close to the Houston program

stories.h: [[t:832438345|Missouri State]]'s fourth-down gambles backfire against [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]]
stories.d: Missouri State went 2-for-4 on fourth down, turning it over on downs twice. Analytics people will defend it, but the fan base is not buying it and the coach is facing pressure, according to a source.

quote.text: You can't live in the numbers when you're losing games.
quote.by: a Missouri State fan on a message board

stories.h: [[t:832438331|Louisiana Tech]] picks off [[p:557713884|L.Duval]] four times
stories.d: Duval threw for 297 yards on 20-of-35 but never found the end zone, and Louisiana Tech's defenders feasted on his mistakes. A source says the quarterback will have a lot to think about this week.

quote.text: We knew where he was going with it. We just sat on it.

stories.h: Four picks from [[p:557726550|T.Walker III]] sink [[t:832438299|Duke]] against [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]]
stories.d: Walker threw three touchdowns but four interceptions, finishing 16-of-37 for 252 yards. A source says the sideline tension was visible as Duke's offense kept handing the ball back.

quote.text: He's a fighter, but those throws can't happen.
quote.by: a source close to the Duke program

stories.h: [[p:557723614|K.Annett]] throws three interceptions as [[t:832438393|UCF]] falls to [[t:832438283|Baylor]]
stories.d: Annett put up 331 yards and two touchdowns on 23-of-42, but the three picks defined the loss. A source says the Knights' staff is already working on cleaning up decision-making.

quote.text: He got greedy a couple times. It happens.
quote.by: a source close to the UCF program

stories.h: [[t:832438279|Arkansas State]] outlasts [[t:832438378|Southern Mississippi]] in overtime, 30-24
stories.d: Regulation couldn't settle it, and Arkansas State took the extra period. A source says Southern Miss will wonder about a couple of late calls, and the loss stings on the road.

quote.text: We had chances. We just didn't take them.
quote.by: a source close to the Southern Miss program

stories.h: [[t:832438413|Wisconsin]] blanks [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] with a dominant defensive effort
stories.d: Michigan State managed just 108 yards and three first downs. A source says Spartans players were frustrated with the play-calling and the offense never found a rhythm.

quote.text: Nothing worked. We couldn't get anything going.
quote.by: a source close to the Michigan State program

stories.h: [[p:557721152|G.Sims]] wrecks [[t:832438374|San Jose State]]'s backfield in a losing effort
stories.d: Sims had three sacks and four tackles for loss among six tackles, a monster game wasted in defeat. Per a source, several bigger programs have taken notice and phone calls could be coming.

quote.text: He's a problem every snap. You can't block him.

stories.h: [[t:832438297|UConn]] flagged 11 times in a sloppy loss to [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]]
stories.d: UConn's 11 penalties cost it 80 yards and a chance at the win. A source says the staff plans a tough, disciplined week of practice.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. Plain and simple.
quote.by: a source close to the UConn program

stories.h: [[t:832438282|Ball State]] commits 13 penalties in loss to [[t:832438412|Western Michigan]]
stories.d: Ball State was flagged 13 times for 114 yards, handing Western Michigan the game. A source says the coach was heated after the game and discipline will be the focus this week.

quote.text: Coach was fired up in the locker room. It was ugly.
quote.by: a source close to the Ball State program

stories.h: [[p:557727732|B.Irvin III]] burns [[t:832438384|Texas]] for 181 yards and two scores
stories.d: Irvin caught five passes and Texas had no answer even after bracketing him. A source says the Longhorns' defensive staff is searching for answers, which could ripple into recruiting where Texas is chasing P. Leber.

quote.text: We doubled him and he still won. That's what hurts.
quote.by: a source close to the Texas program

stories.h: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] rolls [[t:832438318|Illinois]] 49-14 in a total beatdown
stories.d: Michigan piled up 635 yards and never let Illinois breathe. A source says the Illini locker room was heated afterward and players are frustrated, which could fuel portal chatter.

quote.text: It wasn't even a game. We got embarrassed.
quote.by: a source close to the Illinois program

stories.h: [[p:557721289|J.Smith]] torches [[t:832438369|Rice]] for three touchdowns
stories.d: Smith caught six passes for 56 yards and three scores, and Rice's bracket coverage did nothing. A source says other programs are already monitoring his situation as a potential transfer target.

quote.text: He makes every contested catch look easy.

stories.h: [[t:832438325|Kansas State]] goes 2-for-13 on third down in a loss to [[t:832438276|Arizona]]
stories.d: Drives kept dying on the money down for Kansas State. A source says the staff has been 'searching for answers' on third-and-long calls and fans are getting restless.

quote.text: Every third down felt like a punt waiting to happen.
quote.by: a source close to the Kansas State program

stories.h: [[p:557718738|J.Mikhael]] torches [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] for four touchdowns
stories.d: Mikhael caught six passes for 55 yards and four scores despite the bracket coverage. A source says scouts are already adding him to watch lists, and Coastal Carolina's secondary will be hearing about it.

quote.text: He's always in the right place. You can't cover that.

stories.h: [[t:832438375|SMU]] and [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] are in a late fight for five-star WILL [[r:561125692|B. Toviessi]]
stories.d: SMU holds the edge but Oklahoma is pushing hard, with LSU lurking. Toviessi's dealbreaker is conference prestige, and a source says the Sooners' staff has been working that angle all week.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the league. That's what he cares about.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: [[t:832438312|Georgia]] has a slim edge on [[t:832438384|Texas]] for [[r:561122126|P. Leber]], but nothing is settled
stories.d: Georgia holds a slight lead, Texas is right behind and Ohio State is lurking. Leber's dealbreaker is playing style, and Georgia's loss to Mississippi State could shake things up.

quote.text: He wants to see how he fits in the offense. That's the whole thing.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: LSU and Michigan stage a late fight for TE D. Skaggs
stories.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] holds the edge, but [[t:832438339|Michigan]] isn't folding, and Ohio State is lurking. Skaggs wants a championship contender, and that dealbreaker cuts differently for each school.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's actually playing for something in December?
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: BYU barely ahead of Washington for C N. Punga, with A&M lurking
stories.d: Conference prestige is the dealbreaker for the four-star center. [[t:832438288|BYU]] has a slight lead on [[t:832438408|Washington]], and [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] is close enough to crash the finish.

quote.text: The family likes the Provo visit a lot. The league question is what keeps coming up.
quote.by: a source familiar with the process

stories.h: Colorado clings to a lead for MIKE D. Donnell as Florida State closes
stories.d: Playing style is Donnell's dealbreaker. [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is in front, [[t:832438408|Washington]] is still in it, and Florida State has crept to within striking distance.

quote.text: He wants to be used as a weapon, not a spot in the rotation.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Five-star-caliber pickup: J. Barkow picks Oklahoma, eyes immediate snaps
stories.d: The No. 27 overall prospect chose the Sooners after seeing a thin receiver room and a quick route to the field. Per a source close to the recruitment, the depth chart did as much work as the brand.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.

stories.h: LSU lands five-star WR J. Kirkendoll after rivalry rout of A&M
stories.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] gets a headliner for a receiver room about to lose [[p:557724385|M.Elzy]]. A source says the win over [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] sealed what the depth chart had already started.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Notre Dame wins No. 32 overall LB H. Wonnum with a draft-board pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] sold linebacker pipeline, and the rivalry win over [[t:832438346|Navy]] helped. A source says the staff walked [[r:561125329|H. Wonnum]] through the program's recent draft picks at the position.

quote.text: They showed me the draft board. That's where I'm going.

stories.h: Texas Tech's climb keeps paying off as C. Eze joins the Red Raiders
stories.d: A 7-2 record and a No. 12 ranking were the pitch, and the four-star athlete bought it. A rival recruiter admitted Texas Tech's winning "did most of the talking" late in the process.

quote.text: They win. I want to win. Easy.

stories.h: M. Avril stays close to Keller, spurns Texas and LSU for Oklahoma
stories.d: Texas and LSU both made late pushes, but the Sooners' spotlight and a short drive from home won out. Sources say his family was in the room when the decision came together.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.

stories.h: Michigan beats Washington and USC for Q. Rheem on conference pull
stories.d: Michigan's 2-7 record hasn't killed its recruiting. [[r:561121137|Q. Rheem]] wanted a power-conference stage, and the 49-14 win over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] gave the staff something to sell.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: East Carolina keeps K. Meyers home, beating South Carolina
stories.d: A short drive from Marietta helped, but a source says [[c:H0ldStillPlease|H0ldStillPlease]] personally closing it was the real difference. A needed win for a program that's been hurting.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. East Carolina just felt like family.

stories.h: East Carolina adds REDG S. Stepanovich as edge room turns over
stories.d: With [[p:557711449|K.Agurs]] and [[p:557721127|B.Simms III]] both seniors, [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] needed edge help. Stepanovich liked the power-conference feel and a clear path to snaps.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Oregon's NIL muscle lands four-star QB F. Brockel
stories.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] used television exposure and its spending power to get [[r:561125156|F. Brockel]]. A source says the reported $310K asking price was never a sticking point.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Indiana turns a win over Penn State into a four-star commitment
stories.d: G. Brown wanted a title shot, and the Hoosiers' win over No. 18 Penn State gave him a reason to believe. Agerm40's Nittany Lions now have a recruiting talking point to answer.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Nebraska beats Minnesota for WR J. Elling, with Gilmer leaving
stories.d: [[r:561122974|J. Elling]] chose [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] for the Big Ten stage and a room that opens up when [[p:557715333|K.Gilmer]] leaves. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] hoped its pitch would hold.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

stories.h: Michigan lands four-star REDG G. Carver, who watched the Illinois rout
stories.d: [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has a strong DL draft record, and the 49-14 win over [[t:832438318|Illinois]] helped. A source says Carver attended and left convinced.

quote.text: That win over Illinois? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

stories.h: One-star WILL D. Ghent skips home dealbreaker to join East Carolina
stories.d: Ghent wanted to stay close to home, then picked [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] across the country. The thin linebacker room and an open-job pitch swayed him, according to a source.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: W.Wilson is an 89-overall QB paid like a backup
stories.d: [[p:557723218|W.Wilson]] makes nothing in NIL while peers at his rating get serious money. A source says agents and collectives already know it.

quote.text: He's the most underpriced quarterback in the country. Somebody will fix that.

stories.h: B.Riker's price tag is climbing. Can Penn State keep him?
stories.d: [[p:557720389|B.Riker]], an 85-overall center, makes 30K while peers command around 75K. After the loss to Indiana, [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has another reason to worry about holding its line together.

quote.text: Interior linemen at that rating don't stay cheap for long.

stories.h: Liberty has a star RB bargain in K.Davis. It won't last
stories.d: [[p:557714066|K.Davis]], an 88-overall back, makes nothing while peers command around 110K. [[t:832438329|Liberty]] is not built for bidding wars, and richer schools have noticed.

quote.text: He'll get calls the minute the portal opens.
quote.by: a source with a rival program

stories.h: I.West is too good to sit and has options
stories.d: [[p:557722831|I.West]], an 85-overall sophomore back, has played 60 snaps in 8 games. A source says his camp has begun discussing what a portal move could look like.

quote.text: He wants a bigger role. Another year behind people isn't the plan.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Rival collectives circling UCLA's B.Rowe Jr. as pay gap grows
stories.d: [[p:557720624|B.Rowe Jr.]] is a 91-overall receiver making 60K while peers get far more. [[t:832438394|UCLA]] has deep NIL pockets, but rival schools are making calls.

quote.text: Everyone in this business knows what he's worth. UCLA needs to catch up.

stories.h: Ohio State's A.Rogers could leave from No. 4 on the depth chart
stories.d: [[p:557720545|A.Rogers]] is an 84-overall junior back with 46 snaps in 8 games. A source says the situation is starting to wear on him, a test for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he wants to play.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Georgia's leaky pass defense could push elite corner E.Robinson IV toward the portal
stories.d: A 97-overall bump-and-run corner is playing in one of the nation's worst pass defenses. Per a source close to the program, he's frustrated, and other staffs have noticed.

stories.h: J.Carter's ratings say star, but 3.8 a carry says otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557713264|J.Carter]] has 625 yards on 164 carries for a ranked team. A source says the staff is watching the portal for a back who can make more of those runs.

quote.text: The rating is there. The production isn't, and people are noticing.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Q.Porter is too good to sit at 83 snaps in 8 games
stories.d: [[p:557719944|Q.Porter]], a 90-overall junior receiver, is watching a lot of football. A source says other programs have inquired about whether he's gettable.

quote.text: A guy like that should be a focal point. He isn't, and everyone sees it.

stories.h: Notre Dame weighs a change at QB with K.Henderson's numbers
stories.d: [[p:557724785|K.Henderson]]'s 19 touchdowns and 6 interceptions aren't terrible, but expectations for an 89-overall quarterback are high. A source says [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] is quietly considering options.

quote.text: It's not a crisis, but the staff isn't sold either.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: B.Ficklin was supposed to be a star. The numbers say otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557714800|B.Ficklin]], a 90-overall quarterback, has 14 touchdowns against 7 interceptions and a rating that doesn't match the hype. An offseason decision looms.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The results haven't followed.
quote.by: a source familiar with the program

stories.h: Clemson's pass defense has D.Samuel Jr. wondering about a fresh start
stories.d: The 89-overall boundary corner is stuck in a unit ranked near the bottom of the country against the pass. Rivals expect him to at least listen if he enters the portal.

quote.text: Guys like that want to be on an island with help behind them, not a leaky secondary.

stories.h: T.Hawkins has the rating of a star and the stats of a question mark
stories.d: [[p:557715998|T.Hawkins]], an 88-overall quarterback on a ranked team, has 17 touchdowns against 8 interceptions. A source says the staff is bracing for a big offseason call.

quote.text: On a ranked team, you need more than he's giving them.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Oregon's pass defense problems could cost it I.Obidegwu
stories.d: The 89-overall field corner plays for a defense ranked well down the national pass-yardage list. Staffs elsewhere are tracking whether he opts for a new system this offseason.

stories.h: D.Olugbode deserves better than 1-7. Contenders will call
stories.d: [[p:557719455|D.Olugbode]], a 91-overall junior receiver, is stuck on a 1-7 Michigan State team. A source says a few contenders are already thinking about the portal.

quote.text: He's too good to be wasting years on this record.

stories.h: S.Hiter would be portal's top prize if Michigan loses him
stories.d: [[p:557724828|S.Hiter]], a 90-overall sophomore back, is on a 2-7 Michigan team. A source says rival staffs are already working out how they'd pitch him.

quote.text: If he hits the portal, every contender has to call.

stories.h: J.Buchanan deserves better than 2-7. Contenders will call
stories.d: [[p:557712922|J.Buchanan]], an 88-overall junior receiver, is stuck on the same 2-7 Michigan ship as S.Hiter. Another departure would hurt the Wolverines' rebuild.

quote.text: Michigan is losing in the standings and may start losing in the portal.
quote.by: a source with a rival program

stories.h: Five interceptions bury S.Jones and East Carolina against Charlotte
stories.d: The Pirates' quarterback kept throwing into traffic, and Charlotte kept taking the gifts. Pirate_flag now has a week to decide whether this was one ugly afternoon or a pattern.

quote.text: He kept staring down his first read and the safeties knew it by halftime.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Clemson rallies from 11 down in the fourth to stun Boston College
stories.d: Boston College had it in hand heading into the final quarter. Clemson wouldn't let go, and the Eagles' sideline looked shell-shocked as the last drive played out. Nobody in that building will forget it soon.

quote.text: Nobody on our sideline flinched. Not once.

stories.h: Indiana survives Minnesota in a 48-46 overtime shootout
stories.d: Neither defense could get a stop for long, and the extra period only raised the stakes. Indiana finally got the last word. Minnesota's staff will wonder how a game with that much offense slipped away.

stories.h: Mississippi State's fourth-down gambles backfire against Tennessee
stories.d: Mississippi State kept the punt team on the sideline and Tennessee kept getting the ball back near midfield. The staff's aggression has some in the fan base grumbling about game management.

quote.text: You can be bold, but at some point you have to flip the field.

stories.h: Penn State climbs to No. 16 as Agerm40 keeps the streak quiet
stories.d: Six straight wins have the Nittany Lions at 6-1 and back in the national conversation. Agerm40 is trying to keep the noise out of the building, and players say the message is landing. Recruits are noticing too.

quote.text: We don't talk about the streak. We talk about Tuesday practice.

stories.h: Boise State edges Fresno State 33-30 in overtime
stories.d: Boise State won it in the extra period, 6-3, after regulation left both sides gasping. Fresno State had chances to close it out and let them slip. That one will sting on the bus ride home.

stories.h: Six picks from L.Moga sink New Mexico against Air Force
stories.d: New Mexico's quarterback never found a rhythm, and Air Force took full advantage. Moga did throw a touchdown, but the six interceptions were the story. Questions about how long he stays the starter will follow the Lobos all week.

quote.text: You could feel it slipping away after the third one.
quote.by: a source close to the New Mexico program

stories.h: J.Long's three picks hand Georgia a win over Kentucky
stories.d: Kentucky moved the ball but turned it over too often, and Georgia cashed in. The win gives the Bulldogs a nice talking point with the recruits they're chasing, including Tippmann and Leber. Kentucky's quarterback will want this one back.

stories.h: D.Williams Jr. throws for 472 yards as Nebraska handles Washington
stories.d: Nebraska's quarterback was precise all afternoon and never gave Washington a turnover. Pro scouts reportedly circled the game. It was a quiet kind of dominance that deserves more attention.

quote.text: He's the calmest guy in the building and it shows.

stories.h: Georgia State's fourth-down calls fall flat against James Madison
stories.d: Georgia State kept rolling the dice and kept losing the bet. The analytics crowd will defend the approach. Fans leaving the stadium were not buying it, and the grumbling is only getting louder.

quote.text: Just kick it. Please.

stories.h: Miami runs away with the Virginia Tech rivalry game
stories.d: This one was never in doubt. Miami took control early and owns the series for another year. The Hokies' staff will be hearing about it from their fans all week.

stories.h: W.Hammond's 447 yards power Texas Tech past Jacksonville State
stories.d: Texas Tech's offense rolled, and Hammond never threw an interception. Jacksonville State's secondary had no answers. A source says the quarterback is already hearing from NFL-minded agents.

quote.text: Everything he threw was on time and on target.

stories.h: Louisiana's fourth-down tries cost it against Arkansas State
stories.d: Louisiana kept going for it and turning it over on downs, handing Arkansas State short fields. The coaching staff will have to answer for the decision-making this week.

stories.h: J.Reeshad terrorizes Purdue with 3.5 sacks in Oregon win
stories.d: Oregon's pass rusher spent the day in Purdue's backfield and made life miserable for the Boilermakers' quarterback. Rival staffers are already asking about his eligibility timeline.

quote.text: We couldn't block him. Simple as that.

stories.h: A.Schobel throws for 455 yards and five TDs but still loses to Iowa State
stories.d: Schobel did everything a quarterback can do, and it still wasn't enough in a 49-47 defeat. The two interceptions will haunt him. His teammates were visibly crushed afterward.

quote.text: He gave us everything. We let him down.

stories.h: D.Bailey's three interceptions sink Sam Houston against Kennesaw State
stories.d: Sam Houston's quarterback couldn't protect the football, and Kennesaw State pounced. Bailey did throw two touchdowns, but the turnovers killed momentum. The film session will not be pleasant.

stories.h: New Mexico State edges Missouri State 30-27 in overtime
stories.d: New Mexico State won the extra session 6-3 after a back-and-forth game. Missouri State had its chances, and the coaching staff will wonder about a few late decisions.

quote.text: Both teams left everything on the field.
quote.by: a source close to the New Mexico State program

stories.h: Eastern Michigan holds off Ohio 32-30 in overtime
stories.d: Eastern Michigan took the extra period 15-13 in a game that went down to the final snap. Ohio's players were slow to leave the field after the final whistle.

stories.h: Toledo beats Miami University 38-31 in overtime
stories.d: Toledo took the extra period 7-0 to survive. Miami University's sideline was stunned, and the defensive staff will wonder what they could have done differently.

stories.h: Penalties pile up as Middle Tennessee falls to Liberty
stories.d: Middle Tennessee drew 13 flags for 97 yards, and Liberty took advantage. Sources say the head coach was livid on the sideline. Expect a heavy dose of discipline drills this week.

quote.text: Coach made it pretty clear we're not doing this again.

stories.h: LSU takes the Texas A&M rivalry game without much trouble
stories.d: It wasn't close. LSU controlled the game and owns bragging rights for another year. Texas A&M's fans left early, and the pressure on that staff is rising.

stories.h: J.Allen's four sacks lead Memphis past Temple
stories.d: Memphis got a monster game from its defensive lineman, who spent the afternoon in the Temple backfield. Temple's offensive line struggled all day. Scouts are paying attention.

quote.text: Nobody on that line could block him one-on-one.

stories.h: X.Lewis wrecks Stanford's backfield with three sacks in a loss
stories.d: X.Lewis was a one-man wrecking crew against Stanford, with five tackles for loss. The performance wasn't enough to save his team. Rival coaches reportedly took notice.

quote.text: He deserved a better result than that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: San Jose State flagged 12 times in loss to UConn
stories.d: San Jose State beat itself, racking up 95 penalty yards in a loss to UConn. Discipline will be the focus of practice this week, and the head coach didn't hide his frustration afterward.

stories.h: Illinois can't convert on third down in loss to UCLA
stories.d: Illinois went 2-for-11 on third down, and drive after drive died on the money down. The offensive staff will face questions about play-calling in obvious passing situations.

quote.text: We just couldn't stay on the field.

stories.h: M.Hamper torches Florida State for 175 yards and a score
stories.d: The receiver caught eight passes and gave Florida State's corners fits all afternoon. His longest was 52 yards. A Florida State defensive staffer admitted afterward that they had no answer for him.

quote.text: We couldn't cover him. Plain and simple.

stories.h: Georgia holds the edge on Tippmann, but Ohio State is pushing hard
stories.d: Georgia is slightly ahead for B. Tippmann, with Ohio State close behind and Alabama lurking. Proximity to home is his dealbreaker, and official visits could swing it. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff is reportedly planning a big push.

quote.text: He wants to be close to home, and that matters a lot to the family.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Penn State clings to a slim lead for Q. Vigil
stories.d: Agerm40's winning streak is helping, and Penn State barely leads Texas for Q. Vigil, with Florida close behind. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to go all out this week.

quote.text: Winning matters to him, and Penn State is winning.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: SMU and Oklahoma square off for five-star WILL B. Toviessi
stories.d: SMU holds the lead for the five-star linebacker, with Oklahoma pushing and LSU hanging around. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker. Oklahoma sources insist they're not giving up, and the finish should be tense.

quote.text: Oklahoma isn't going quietly. They think they can flip this.

stories.h: Texas leads Georgia for P. Leber, but the Bulldogs aren't backing down
stories.d: Texas has a modest lead for P. Leber, with Georgia close behind and Ohio State farther back. His dealbreaker is playing style, and the Bulldogs' win over Kentucky helps their pitch. Somebody is getting heartbroken.

quote.text: He wants to see where he fits in the scheme, and both staffs know it.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Notre Dame and Utah are staring each other down for five-star Virgin
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] has a slight edge for athlete [[r:561124114|C. Virgin]], but [[t:832438400|Utah]] hasn't blinked and SMU is still in the picture. Playing time is the dealbreaker, and both staffs know it.

quote.text: He's asked every coach the same question: where do I line up in September? That's the whole recruitment.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Colorado holds a thin lead for Manuwai, but Georgia is pushing back hard
stories.d: [[t:832438295|Colorado]] is slightly ahead for four-star linebacker [[r:561119798|L. Manuwai]], who cares most about playing style. [[t:832438312|Georgia]] is not conceding, and LSU is still lurking.

quote.text: He wants to know how he'll be used, not how the helmet looks. Whoever sells that best wins.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: Georgia gets its man: five-star receiver Duggan picks the Bulldogs
stories.d: [[r:561120351|J. Duggan]] wanted a team built for January, and [[t:832438312|Georgia]] gave him the strongest pitch. The NIL ranking didn't hurt, with his reported asking price at $410K.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: Reinbolt picks Alabama after the Tide's win over Florida sealed it
stories.d: [[r:561124450|A. Reinbolt]] fell for the head coach's honesty, and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]'s win over No. 24 [[t:832438308|Florida]] only made the decision easier. Rivals reportedly saw this coming weeks ago.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

stories.h: Indiana wins Hamrick, and the Minnesota result carried real weight
stories.d: Four-star linebacker [[r:561121384|T. Hamrick]] is headed to [[t:832438319|Indiana]], which strengthened its title pitch with a win over No. 18 [[t:832438342|Minnesota]]. The Hoosiers' title case played well in the final calls.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Texas Tech beat LSU and Kansas State for Pope after a blowout win
stories.d: [[r:561120600|M. Pope]] chose [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] over [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438325|Kansas State]]. The 52-14 win over [[t:832438322|Jacksonville State]] looked like a statement to him, and he said so privately.

quote.text: Watching them play, I could see myself in that locker room, and that's what I wanted.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ole Miss gets a rusher who sees a clear path to playing time
stories.d: [[r:561125736|J. Abbott]] saw seniors [[p:557719851|Y.Pierre]] and [[p:557715042|K.Franklin]] about to graduate and committed to [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]]. The Rebels' record of producing NFL defensive linemen helped too.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

stories.h: Notre Dame beats Texas and Michigan for Hammer after the USC win
stories.d: [[r:561125364|J. Hammer]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] over [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438339|Michigan]]. The 21-16 rivalry win over [[t:832438398|USC]] reportedly closed the deal, and the Irish are in a good week on the trail.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Utah wins Davis on the strength of its head coach's pitch
stories.d: [[r:561123749|J. Davis]] chose [[t:832438400|Utah]], where [[p:557714121|E.Day]] and [[p:557718724|J.Mickens]] are about to leave a hole at edge. It's a good day in Salt Lake, even with the Virgin race still undecided.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

stories.h: Oregon's NFL line pipeline lands another tackle in Jose
stories.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has a standout offensive line development record, and [[r:561119452|A. Jose]] bought it. His reported ask was $265K, and the Ducks' NIL muscle matched it, according to people around the process.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

stories.h: Ole Miss adds a second edge rusher, and Burns wanted the spotlight
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has now landed another edge rusher in [[r:561121196|P. Burns]], who valued the TV exposure as much as the depth chart. The Rebels' defensive line pipeline sealed it.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: LeBeau picks Oklahoma after being told the receiver job is wide open
stories.d: [[r:561124523|C. LeBeau]] liked the spotlight at [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] but loved the short path to snaps. With only seven receivers returning, a staff source says the coaches were blunt about the opportunity.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: UCLA beats BYU for Ojulari, who loved the head coach
stories.d: [[r:561123309|K. Ojulari]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438288|BYU]] after what he called an honest recruiting pitch. His reported $255K ask fit the Bruins' NIL room.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.

stories.h: Clemson lands Doss, who wanted the brand and got it
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] adds athlete [[r:561123468|B. Doss]], who wanted a national stage and a reported $285K. The staff has been busy since that wild comeback over Boston College.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Texas lands Paillant, a small win after losing Hammer
stories.d: [[r:561124212|M. Paillant]] picked [[t:832438384|Texas]], which has an opening at linebacker once [[p:557721040|K.Sherman]] graduates. After losing Hammer to Notre Dame, the Longhorns needed this.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops linebackers better than anybody.

stories.h: Ansah picks Texas A&M even after calling home a dealbreaker
stories.d: [[r:561125337|D. Ansah]] had listed proximity as a must, then picked [[t:832438385|Texas A&M]] anyway. The Aggies' thin linebacker room and a direct pitch about playing time apparently outweighed everything.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.

stories.h: Miami adds Emery, and the Virginia Tech win helped
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] landed edge rusher [[r:561125516|J. Emery]], who wants to chase a national title. The 32-18 win over [[t:832438406|Virginia Tech]] came at a perfect time.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.

stories.h: California's Goedeke stays home and commits to UCLA
stories.d: [[r:561123015|E. Goedeke]] never really considered leaving the Golden State, and [[t:832438394|UCLA]] benefited. His reported $270K ask was no problem for the Bruins' NIL budget.

quote.text: I'm representing San Juan Capistrano. Staying close was always the plan.

stories.h: USC lands Heflin, a receiver who wants the national stage
stories.d: [[r:561119694|L. Heflin]] chose [[t:832438398|USC]] for the exposure, and the Trojans' track record at receiver made it easy. It's a quiet bounce-back after the loss to Notre Dame.

quote.text: Every week we're on TV. That matters for my brand.

stories.h: Miami adds another title-chaser in linebacker Wells
stories.d: [[r:561123609|L. Wells]] picked [[t:832438337|Miami]] because he wants a title shot, and the spot left by [[p:557720045|C.Pruitt]] is a bonus. The Canes' recruiting classes keep stacking.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

stories.h: Nebraska runs away with Coffee, leaving Florida in the dust
